Humanoid authors in Three.js Y-up with own coordinates. For non-humanoid creature, data is Z-up... Confusing. But the animated creature doc never says Y-up. The export normalization applies a fixed -90X for bones, and for meshes preserves world transform?? Let's re-read: `shouldPreserveDisplayWorldTransform` returns true for mesh nodes (keep their post-rotation world transform). For non-mesh nodes (bones), it applies the +90X quaternion correction after rotating the hierarchy by -90X... Hmm let's carefully reason:

1. It applies basisCorrection (-90X) to root children (so whole hierarchy rotated: Z-up → Y-up).
2. Then for each object, computes desired world = current world (after rotation).
3. For objects that are NOT meshes and NOT *_Mesh/Node- groups, it multiplies quaternion by +90X. Then recomputes desiredWorld... wait order: it computes desiredWorldTransforms from matrixWorld BEFORE applying rotationCorrection? No: it first applies basis correction, then updateMatrixWorld, then traverse computing desiredWorld from matrixWorld, then afterwards `if (!preserve) quaternion.multiply(rotationCorrection)`. So the desired world for non-mesh = rotated world with an extra +90X rotation → net rotation = identity relative to authored. Meaning: the bone's world quaternion comes back to the authored value, but its position is Y-up converted. So bones end up with Y-up positions but Z-up-ish rotations (compensated).

That's the Unity expectation: Unity bones have positions in Y-up but rotations in a different convention. Whatever — the pipeline handles it.

For meshes, world transform preserved (positions rotated to Y-up).

So visible meshes should be authored in the same Z-up space as the skeleton. Good: my plan works — place shell using worldPos (raw data world coords) in authored space.

So in the editor preview, everything is Z-up (lying down in a Y-up viewer?) — but perhaps the app previews with the same normalization. Not critical.

local function clamp(value, minValue, maxValue)
    if value < minValue then
        return minValue
    end
    if value > maxValue then
        return maxValue
    end
    return value
end

local function ensure_adapter_runtime(hostRuntime)
    local storage = hostRuntime or EMBEDDED_RUNTIME
    local adapterRuntime = storage.__generatedControllerAdapter
    if adapterRuntime == nil then
        adapterRuntime = {
            animator = nil,
            hashes = {},
            state = {},
            isMounted = false,
            lastMountedRider = nil,
            lastTurnIntent = 0,
            lastForwardIntent = 0,
            lastJumpIntent = false,
            lastVerticalIntent = 0,
        }
        adapterRuntime.state.MoveState = DEFAULTS.MoveState
        storage.__generatedControllerAdapter = adapterRuntime
    end
    return adapterRuntime
end

local function get_param_hash(hostRuntime, paramName)
    local adapterRuntime = ensure_adapter_runtime(hostRuntime)
    local hash = adapterRuntime.hashes[paramName]
    if hash == nil then
        hash = Animator.StringToHash(paramName)
        adapterRuntime.hashes[paramName] = hash
    end
    return hash
end

function GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.EnsureAnimator(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    local adapterRuntime = ensure_adapter_runtime(hostRuntime)
    if adapterRuntime.animator ~= nil then
        return adapterRuntime.animator
    end
    if hostRuntime ~= nil and hostRuntime.animator ~= nil then
        adapterRuntime.animator = hostRuntime.animator
        return adapterRuntime.animator
    end
    if scriptSelf == nil or scriptSelf.gameObject == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local animator = scriptSelf.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(Animator))
    if animator ~= nil then
        animator.cullingMode = AnimatorCullingMode.AlwaysAnimate
    else
        animator = scriptSelf.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(Animator))
        animator.cullingMode = AnimatorCullingMode.AlwaysAnimate
        adapterLogger:warn("Sheep_Controller_Param_Embedded: Animator component was missing and has been added automatically.")
    end
    adapterRuntime.animator = animator
    if hostRuntime ~= nil and hostRuntime.animator == nil then
        hostRuntime.animator = animator
    end
    return animator
end

function GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.BindHost(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    local adapterRuntime = ensure_adapter_runtime(hostRuntime)
    if hostRuntime ~= nil and hostRuntime.controlProfile ~= nil then
        adapterRuntime.controlProfile = hostRuntime.controlProfile
    end
    GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.EnsureAnimator(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    return adapterRuntime
end

function GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.OnHostStart(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.EnsureAnimator(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    return true
end

function GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.OnMountedStateChanged(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, isMounted, riderOrNil)
    local adapterRuntime = ensure_adapter_runtime(hostRuntime)
    adapterRuntime.isMounted = isMounted == true
    adapterRuntime.lastMountedRider = riderOrNil
    if adapterRuntime.isMounted then
        return GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.SetMoveMode(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, "idle")
    end
    return GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.ApplyNeutralIdleDefaults(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
end

function GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.OnMountedInput(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, moveMode, turnIntent, forwardIntent, jumpIntent, verticalIntent)
    local adapterRuntime = ensure_adapter_runtime(hostRuntime)
    adapterRuntime.lastTurnIntent = tonumber(turnIntent) or 0
    adapterRuntime.lastForwardIntent = tonumber(forwardIntent) or 0
    adapterRuntime.lastJumpIntent = jumpIntent == true
    adapterRuntime.lastVerticalIntent = tonumber(verticalIntent) or 0
    return GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.ApplyMountedLocomotion(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, moveMode, turnIntent, forwardIntent)
end

function GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.OnHostStop(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    local adapterRuntime = ensure_adapter_runtime(hostRuntime)
    adapterRuntime.lastTurnIntent = 0
    adapterRuntime.lastForwardIntent = 0
    adapterRuntime.lastJumpIntent = false
    adapterRuntime.lastVerticalIntent = 0
    return true
end

local function set_bool(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, paramName, value)
    local animator = GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.EnsureAnimator(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    if animator == nil then
        return false
    end
    animator:SetBool(get_param_hash(hostRuntime, paramName), value and true or false)
    return true
end

local function set_float(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, paramName, value)
    local animator = GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.EnsureAnimator(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    if animator == nil then
        return false
    end
    animator:SetFloat(get_param_hash(hostRuntime, paramName), value)
    return true
end

local function set_int(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, paramName, value)
    local animator = GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.EnsureAnimator(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    if animator == nil then
        return false
    end
    animator:SetInteger(get_param_hash(hostRuntime, paramName), value)
    return true
end

local function pulse_trigger(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, paramName)
    local animator = GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.EnsureAnimator(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    if animator == nil then
        return false
    end
    animator:SetTrigger(get_param_hash(hostRuntime, paramName))
    return true
end

local function reset_trigger(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, paramName)
    local animator = GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.EnsureAnimator(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    if animator == nil then
        return false
    end
    animator:ResetTrigger(get_param_hash(hostRuntime, paramName))
    return true
end

local function full_state_name(stateName)
    if stateName == nil or stateName == "" then
        return nil
    end
    if string.find(stateName, ".", 1, true) ~= nil then
        return stateName
    end
    return "Base Layer." .. stateName
end

function GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.CrossFadeState(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, stateName, fadeSeconds, layer)
    local animator = GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.EnsureAnimator(scriptSelf, hostRuntime)
    local fullName = full_state_name(stateName)
    if animator == nil or fullName == nil then
        return false
    end
    animator:CrossFadeInFixedTime(fullName, fadeSeconds or 0.15, layer or 0)
    return true
end

function GENERATED_CONTROLLER_ADAPTER.SetMoveStateValue(scriptSelf, hostRuntime, value)
    local adapterRuntime = ensure_adapter_runtime(hostRuntime)
    adapterRuntime.state.MoveState = math.floor(tonumber(value) or DEFAULTS.MoveState)

parts.text:
Now the approach for behavior:
- Use rig template `ms` with rigFamily creature, capability "1", controlProfile auto from rig facts (land).
- The generated ms-root.lua will bind animator, stay idle, and expose extensions. I'll then add an autonomous sheep AI extension inside ms-root.lua (allowed "扩展位置") using the adapter to trigger IdleGraze/IdleChew/IdleLookAround and MoveState walk/run, plus move root transform.

I need to see the generated ms-root.lua to know the structure. Generate it after rig facts.

Important: the user's specific motions (legs alternating, body bob, grazing, ears/tail) come from the Sheep animator states:
- Walk state = walking animation with legs alternating and body bob.
- IdleGraze etc. = grazing; idle states include ear/tail movement presumably.
- Run = flee.

Great. We also need fleeing "turn around and walk away" — we can implement: when player within e.g. 2.2m, sheep rotates away from player and walks/runs a few meters; then resumes grazing.

Also "自己慢慢游荡" — pick random points within a radius, walk slowly, pause, graze.

Now the visual model. Requirements: realistic sheep, fluffy cream wool as one big mass (no bobble spheres), dark grey short-haired face and four legs, small ears drooping to sides, body length ~1.2m, not cartoonish.

The skeleton has a body length ~1.16 (bounds forward). Our visible shell: wool body big ellipsoid with noise displacement (single continuous blob, maybe 2-3 overlapping blobs by torso bones but visually one mass), head dark grey, legs dark grey thin cylinders/tapered, ears drooping.

Since we hang meshes on bones, and the animator deforms bones, meshes attached rigidly to bones will move. The wool should attach mostly to spine/spine1/pelvis. Legs to leg bones.

Body length 1.2m matches skeleton. Height ~0.7m at head; player 0.84 tall. Good.

Let's now design the control tree math.

First compute controlDefs (local transforms + worldPos) with a script. I'll write a temp node script using THREE from the app bundle. Check three-bundle path exists: $OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR/tools/dist-depend/three-bundle.mjs.

Approach details for conversion (matching transform-converter):
- tree.isGlobal = true, platform 'ThreeJS', rotationMode 'quaternion'
- for each node: worldMatrix = compose(pos, quat, scale)
- localMatrix = inv(parentWorld) * worldMatrix
- decompose → pos, quat, scale
- round pos 4 decimals, quat 6, scale 6
- worldPos = raw global pos rounded 4.

Round then attachWorldPositions uses rounded locals to compute world (which reproduces raw within rounding). I'll compute worldPos using the rounded locals (like the script does via localTreeToGlobal), to be exact.

Validation: duplicate names, self parents, missing parents, keyBones present.

metaSkeleton: as buildMetaSkeleton.

I'll output JSON with entry, skeletonFacts, validation, metaSkeleton, controlDefs to temp.

Then generate preview-module.js: I'll inline BONE_DEFS (name, parent, pos, rot, scale) and build tree.

But hold on: should the export root be 'rig'? validation.roots = ['rig'] presumably. Good.

Also the doc: previewRoot wrapper with exportRootName = 'rig', profile for_unity.

Now visible shell placement in raw coordinate space: up=+Z, forward=-Y. I'll author using a "semantic frame" helper: given a bone's world position and desired offsets in (x=right, forward, up) → convert to raw: rawX = right, rawY = -forward, rawZ = up.

Simplest: for each bone group, add meshes with positions expressed in the bone's local space. Since bone local axes may be rotated weirdly, better to attach world-space geometry: create meshes positioned in world (attachment) space and use `bone.attach(mesh)` so world transform preserved, but then bone animation moves it rigidly (with its world offset rotated by bone). That's fine and standard.

Yet the export normalization: meshes preserve world transform; fine.

Hmm, careful: `shouldPreserveDisplayWorldTransform` returns true for meshes but for groups (e.g., a group holding head mesh) it applies quaternion correction... If I attach Groups (not meshes) under bones, their local rotations get extra +90X compensation... Actually the correction ensures the group's *world* rotation becomes authoredRotation * +90X? Let me recompute: after basisCorrection, world = R(-90X) * authored. For non-preserved nodes, they set quaternion = worldQuat * R(+90X) → desiredWorld = R(-90X) * authored * R(+90X). Then positions from rotated space. Hmm, that means bones' orientations are compensated to keep local axes semantics (Unity bone convention).

For a mesh child (preserved), world = R(-90X)*authoredWorld, i.e., rotated upright. Its local rotation relative to compensated parent = parentWorld^-1 * meshWorld = (R-90 * A_p * R+90)^-1 * (R-90 * A_m) ... = R-90 * A_p^-1 * R+90 * R-90 * A_m = R-90 * A_p^-1 * A_m. So mesh local rotation includes R(-90X) applied to its authored local rotation. Positions: mesh world position = R-90 * authoredPos. So geometry itself also gets rotated: the mesh's local matrix includes R-90 * authoredLocal, so the mesh geometry (in its own local axes) is rotated by -90 about X in the final GLB. Wait the mesh's world = parentDesiredWorld * local, and world position is R-90*authored. The mesh's rotation is R-90 * authoredMeshWorldQuat... So yes, the entire model gets rotated upright in the exported GLB.

For SkinnedMesh we're not using skinning; rigid attachment. Fine. The visual result: exported upright, as intended. 

But wait — then why is the skeleton Z-up? Because assets derive from Blender. OK.

Now, will the editor preview show it sideways? Probably the preview also uses the same pipeline (the app's inspector). I'll check with inspect_resource_nodes after writing.

Let me now write the conversion script.

Note: rounding and output format — I'll generate a compact JSON and then transform into JS literal for preview.

Let me also get noMeshBones (rig, SK_Sheep, root) — these shouldn't carry main visible shell.

Let me write the temp script.

parts.text:
Control tree created; worlds are Z-up and forward -Y.

Now build the visible sheep. Key design decisions:

Coordinate frame in authored space: up = +Z, forward = -Y, right = +X.
World positions:
- Pelvis (0, 0.23, 0.6)
- Spine (0, 0.08, 0.52)
- Spine1 (0, -0.11, 0.52)
- Neck (0, -0.3, 0.55)
- Neck1 (0,-0.39,0.58)
- Neck2 (0,-0.48,0.62)
- Head (0,-0.55,0.7)
- Tail (0,0.36,0.65), Tail1 (0,0.42,0.6), Tail2 (0,0.49,0.52)
- Hind legs: L Thigh (0.1,0.23,0.6) → Calf (0.1,0.15,0.33) → HorseLink (0.08,0.28,0.25) → Foot (0.07,0.27,0.1) → Foot_end (0.12,0.13,0.1)
   Wait hind leg calf at z=0.33, horseLink z=0.25, foot z=0.1. So hind legs go down from 0.6 to 0.1.
- Front legs: L Clavicle (0.02,-0.32,0.5) → UpperArm (0.09,-0.35,0.45) → Forearm (0.07,-0.25,0.33) → Hand (0.07,-0.27,0.17) → Finger0 (0.07,-0.28,0.08) → Finger0_end.

So front legs at y≈-0.27 (forward), z from 0.5 down to 0.08. Hind legs at y≈+0.2 (back), z 0.6→0.1. Body length from head y=-0.55 to tail y=+0.49 ≈ 1.04 plus head nose extends → ~1.2m total. 

The body core: from y≈+0.35 (rear) to y≈-0.2 (front chest), z center ~0.42, size: width 0.32, depth (length) 0.62, height 0.38. A sheep body: 1.2m long total including head/neck; torso ~0.65m.

Wool mass: a large ellipsoid with noise displacement, spanning pelvis→spine1→chest, plus neck/shoulder wool. Attach primarily to Spine1? Rigid attachment to a single bone means when animator bends spine, wool won't deform, but it's fine-ish? Better: split wool into 2-3 overlapping volumes attached to Pelvis, Spine, Spine1 so it bends slightly. function fbm(dir, seed) {
```
  const a = Math.sin(dir.x*7.3 + seed)*Math.cos(dir.y*6.1 - seed*1.7)*Math.sin(dir.z*8.2 + seed*2.3);
  const b = Math.sin(dir.x*15.1 - seed*0.7)*Math.cos(dir.y*13.7 + seed)*Math.sin(dir.z*16.3 + seed*1.1);
  return a*0.7 + b*0.3;
}
```

671:         )

674:     local forwardIntent = resolveForwardIntent()
675:     local result =
676:         callAdapter(
677:         "OnMountedInput",
678:         self,
679:         hostRuntime,
680:         hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
681:         hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
682:         forwardIntent,
683:         hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent,
684:         hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent
685:     )
686: 
687:     if result == nil then
688:         result =
689:             callAdapter(
690:             "ApplyMountedLocomotion",
691:             self,
692:             hostRuntime,
693:             hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
694:             hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
695:             forwardIntent,
696:             hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent,
697:             hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent
698:         )
699:     end
700: 
701:     if result == nil and controlProfile ~= "land" then
702:         if controlProfile == "fish" then
703:             motionLogger:warnOnce(
704:                 "fish-fallback",
705:                 "fish profile is retaining fish semantics while reusing flying-style mounted locomotion glue"
706:             )
707:         end
708:         -- `flying` / `fish` vertical intent is still retained on the host even when
709:         -- the current adapter only consumes move/turn/forward.
710:         callAdapter(
711:             "ApplyMountedLocomotion",
712:             self,
713:             hostRuntime,
714:             hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
715:             hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
716:             forwardIntent
717:         )
718:     end

720:     local currentTransform = self and self.transform or nil
721:     if currentTransform ~= nil and dt ~= nil and dt > 0 then
722:         ensureFacingCalibration(currentTransform, false)

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = UnityEngine.Time

local adapterPeer = nil

local hostRuntime = {

    rb = nil,
    adapterDefaultMoveMode = "idle",
    adapterHasMountedGlue = false,
    adapterHasNeutralIdleGlue = false,
    adapterIdentifier = nil,
    adapterProfileSupported = true,

local function loadTypedResource(path, resourceType)
    if path == nil or path == "" or resourceType == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, resource =
        pcall(
        function()
            return UnityEngine.Resources.Load(path, resourceType)
        end
    )
    if ok then
        return resource
    end
    motionLogger:warn("resource load failed", path, "error=" .. tostring(resource))
    return nil
end

local function abs(value)
    if value < 0 then
        return -value
    end
    return value
end

local function resolveAdapter()
    if type(generatedControllerAdapter) == "table" then
        return generatedControllerAdapter
    end
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("adapter-scope-unavailable", "controller adapter scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
        return nil
    end
    if adapterPeer == nil then
        adapterPeer = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-rig-adapter.lua")
    end
    if adapterPeer == nil or type(adapterPeer.GetRigControllerAdapter) ~= "function" then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("adapter-script-unavailable", "controller adapter script unavailable")
        return nil
    end
    local ok, adapter = pcall(adapterPeer.GetRigControllerAdapter)
    if not ok then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("adapter-contract-unavailable", "controller adapter contract unavailable")
        return nil
    end
    if adapter == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(adapter) ~= "table" then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("adapter-contract-invalid", "controller adapter contract must be a table")
        return nil
    end
    generatedControllerAdapter = adapter
    return generatedControllerAdapter
end

local function adapterHasMethod(methodName)
    local adapter = resolveAdapter()
    return adapter ~= nil and type(adapter[methodName]) == "function"
end

local function callAdapter(methodName, ...)
    local adapter = resolveAdapter()
    if adapter == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local fn = adapter[methodName]
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
    if ok then
        return result
    end
    motionLogger:info("adapter call failed", methodName)
    return nil
end

local function syncHostFacts()
    hostRuntime.capability = capability
    hostRuntime.controlProfile = controlProfile
    hostRuntime.bindingMode = bindingMode
    hostRuntime.avatarResourcePath = avatarResourcePath
    hostRuntime.controllerResourcePath = controllerResourcePath
    hostRuntime.scriptFilePath = scriptFilePath
    hostRuntime.defaultMoveSpeed = defaultMoveSpeed
    hostRuntime.defaultRunSpeed = defaultRunSpeed
    hostRuntime.turnSpeed = turnSpeed
    hostRuntime.ascendSpeed = ascendSpeed
    hostRuntime.descendSpeed = descendSpeed
    hostRuntime.groundProbeDistance = groundProbeDistance
    hostRuntime.groundProbeUpDistance = groundProbeUpDistance
    hostRuntime.groundContactOffset = groundContactOffset
end

local function syncAdapterFacts()
    local adapter = resolveAdapter()
    if adapter == nil then
        hostRuntime.adapterIdentifier = nil
        hostRuntime.adapterDefaultMoveMode = "idle"
        hostRuntime.adapterHasMountedGlue = false
        hostRuntime.adapterHasNeutralIdleGlue = false
        hostRuntime.adapterProfileSupported = true
        hostRuntime.adapterSupportedControlProfiles = nil
        return
    end

    hostRuntime.adapterIdentifier = adapter.IDENTIFIER or adapter.CONTROLLER_NAME or adapter.controllerName or "unknown"
    hostRuntime.adapterDefaultMoveMode = adapter.DEFAULT_MOVE_MODE or "idle"
    hostRuntime.adapterHasMountedGlue = adapterHasMethod("OnMountedInput") or adapterHasMethod("ApplyMountedLocomotion")
    hostRuntime.adapterHasNeutralIdleGlue =
        adapterHasMethod("ApplyNeutralIdleDefaults") or adapterHasMethod("ApplyDefaults")
    hostRuntime.adapterSupportedControlProfiles = adapter.SUPPORTED_CONTROL_PROFILES
    hostRuntime.adapterProfileSupported =
        type(adapter.SUPPORTED_CONTROL_PROFILES) ~= "table" or
        table.concat(adapter.SUPPORTED_CONTROL_PROFILES, ","):find(controlProfile, 1, true) ~= nil

    if not hostRuntime.adapterProfileSupported then
        motionLogger:warnOnce(
            "adapter-profile-unsupported",
            "adapter " ..
                tostring(hostRuntime.adapterIdentifier) ..
                    " does not declare support for controlProfile=" .. tostring(controlProfile)
        )
    end

    motionLogger:info(
        "adapter facts: identifier=" ..
            tostring(hostRuntime.adapterIdentifier) ..
                ", defaultMoveMode=" ..
                    tostring(hostRuntime.adapterDefaultMoveMode) .. ", profile=" .. tostring(controlProfile)
    )
end

local function resolveMountedIdleMode()
    local adapterMode = hostRuntime.adapterDefaultMoveMode
    if adapterMode ~= nil and adapterMode ~= "" then
        return tostring(adapterMode)
    end
    return "idle"
end

local function clearMountedIntents()
    hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = resolveMountedIdleMode()
    hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent = 0
    hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent = 0
    hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent = false
    hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent = 0
end

local function resolveRootGameObject()
    if hostRuntime.rootGameObject ~= nil then
        return hostRuntime.rootGameObject
    end
    if self == nil or self.gameObject == nil or self.gameObject.transform == nil then
        return nil
    end

    hostRuntime.rootGameObject = self.gameObject
    return hostRuntime.rootGameObject
end

local function applyBindingFacts()
    local rootGameObject = resolveRootGameObject()
    if rootGameObject == nil then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("root-gameobject-missing", "Root GameObject is missing; animator binding skipped.")
        return
    end

    hostRuntime.animator = rootGameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
    if hostRuntime.animator == nil then
        hostRuntime.animator = rootGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
        motionLogger:warn("Animator component was missing on root GameObject and has been added automatically by host binding.")
    end

    hostRuntime.animator.cullingMode = UnityEngine.AnimatorCullingMode.CullUpdateTransforms
    hostRuntime.animator.applyRootMotion = false

    local hasAvatar = hostRuntime.animator.avatar ~= nil
    local hasController = hostRuntime.animator.runtimeAnimatorController ~= nil

    if bindingMode == "controller_avatar" and hasAvatar and hasController then
        return
    end

    if bindingMode == "avatar_only" and hasAvatar then
        return
    end

    if bindingMode == "controller_avatar" then
        if not hasAvatar then
            local avatar = loadTypedResource(avatarResourcePath, typeof(UnityEngine.Avatar))
            if avatar ~= nil then
                hostRuntime.animator.avatar = avatar
            end
        end
        if not hasController then
            local controller = loadTypedResource(controllerResourcePath, typeof(UnityEngine.RuntimeAnimatorController))
            if controller ~= nil then
                hostRuntime.animator.runtimeAnimatorController = controller
            end
        end
        return
    end

    if bindingMode == "avatar_only" then
        if not hasAvatar then
            local avatar = loadTypedResource(avatarResourcePath, typeof(UnityEngine.Avatar))
            if avatar ~= nil then
                hostRuntime.animator.avatar = avatar
            end
        end
    end
end

local groundPeer = nil

local function resolveGroundPeer()
    if groundPeer ~= nil then
        return groundPeer
    end
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        motionLogger:warnOnce("grounding-scope-unavailable", "rig grounding scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
        return nil
    end
    local peer, reason = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-rig-grounding.lua")

        peer == nil or type(peer.EnforceRigRigidbodySettings) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.EnsureRigFacingCalibration) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.GetRigHorizontalForward) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.RotateRigHorizontal) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.ResolveRigGroundedPose) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.ApplyRigGroundAlignedRotation) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.RefreshRigMountedGrounding) ~= "function" or
            type(peer.RefreshRigUnmountedGrounding) ~= "function" or

     then

        return nil
    end

end

local function ensureFacingCalibration(root, forceRefresh)

end

local function enforceMountedRigidBodySettings()
    return callGround("EnforceRigRigidbodySettings")
end

local function resolveGroundedPose(root, candidatePosition, deltaTime, forceResetOffset, immediateSnap, shouldWarnOnMiss)

    if peer == nil then
        return candidatePosition, nil

    return peer.ResolveRigGroundedPose(
        hostRuntime,
        root,
        candidatePosition,
        deltaTime,
        forceResetOffset,
        immediateSnap,

        return hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent

local function adapterCallSucceeded(result)

end

end

local function appendSnapshotStateGroupCandidates(candidates, snapshot, groupName)
    if type(snapshot) ~= "table" or type(snapshot.stateGroups) ~= "table" then
        return
    end
    local group = snapshot.stateGroups[groupName]
    if type(group) ~= "table" then
        return
    end
    for i = 1, #group do
        appendStateCandidate(candidates, group[i])
    end
end

local function resetAdapterTriggerMethods(triggerNames)
    if type(triggerNames) ~= "table" then
        return false
    end

    local didReset = false
    for i = 1, #triggerNames do
        local triggerName = triggerNames[i]
        if type(triggerName) == "string" and triggerName ~= "" then
            local methodName = "Reset" .. triggerName
            if adapterHasMethod(methodName) then
                local result = callAdapter(methodName, self, hostRuntime)
                if result ~= nil then
                    didReset = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return didReset
end

local function resetNeutralIdleTriggers()
    local adapter = resolveAdapter()
    if adapter ~= nil then
        resetAdapterTriggerMethods(adapter.TRIGGER_PARAMS)
        resetAdapterTriggerMethods(adapter.NEUTRAL_IDLE_RESET_TRIGGERS)
    end

    tryAdapterMethodList(
        {
            "ResetTriggerDeath",
            "ResetTriggerDeathGrounded",
            "ResetTriggerDeathHitTheGround",
            "ResetTriggerDeathGoToFall",
            "ResetTriggerRevive",
            "ResetTriggerGetHit",
            "ResetTriggerGetHitFront",
            "ResetTriggerGetHitLeft",
            "ResetTriggerGetHitRight",
            "ResetTriggerGlide",
            "ResetTriggerTakeOffGrounded",
            "ResetTriggerTakeOffBranch",
            "ResetTriggerLandingGrounded",
            "ResetTriggerLandingBranch"
        },
        self,
        hostRuntime
    )
end

local function tryCrossFadeAdapterStates(stateNames, visualStateKey)
    if hostRuntime.visualStateKey == visualStateKey then
        return true
    end
    if type(stateNames) ~= "table" then
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #stateNames do
        local stateName = stateNames[i]
        if type(stateName) == "string" and stateName ~= "" then
            local ok = callAdapter("CrossFadeState", self, hostRuntime, stateName, 0.15, 0)
            if ok == true then
                hostRuntime.visualStateKey = visualStateKey
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function tryCrossFadeAdapterSnapshotIdleState(visualStateKey)
    local snapshot = callAdapter("GetAnimatorSnapshot", hostRuntime)
    local candidates = {}

    appendSnapshotStateGroupCandidates(candidates, snapshot, "idle")
    appendSnapshotStateGroupCandidates(candidates, snapshot, "grounded_idle")
    appendSnapshotStateGroupCandidates(candidates, snapshot, "groundedIdle")
    appendSnapshotStateGroupCandidates(candidates, snapshot, "neutralIdle")

    if #candidates == 0 then
        return false
    end

    return tryCrossFadeAdapterStates(candidates, visualStateKey)
end

local function applyGroundedIdleVisualState()
    if hostRuntime.visualStateKey == "grounded_idle" then
        return true
    end

    resetNeutralIdleTriggers()

    if tryCrossFadeAdapterSnapshotIdleState("grounded_idle") then
        return true
    end

    local idlePulseResult =
        tryAdapterMethodList(
        {
            "PulseTriggerIdleLookAroundGrounded",
            "PulseTriggerIdleStretchWingsGrounded",
            "PulseTriggerIdleLookStretchLegsGrounded",
            "PulseTriggerIdleStareBranch",
            "PulseTriggerIdleLookAroundBranch",
            "PulseTriggerIdleStretchWingsBranch",
            "PulseTriggeridleFlapWings"
        },
        self,
        hostRuntime
    )
    if idlePulseResult ~= nil then
        hostRuntime.visualStateKey = "grounded_idle"
        return true
    end

    return tryCrossFadeAdapterStates(
        {
            "IdleStareGrounded",
            "IdleLookAroundGrounded",
            "IdleStretchWingsGrounded",
            "IdleStareBranch",
            "IdleLookAroundBranch",
            "IdleStretchWingsBranch"
        },
        "grounded_idle"
    )
end

local function applyMountedFlightVisualState(airborneTransition)
    if airborneTransition and not hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed then
        tryAdapterMethodList(
            {
                "PulseTriggerTakeOffGrounded",
                "PulseTriggerTakeOffBranch"
            },
            self,
            hostRuntime
        )
        hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = true
    end

    local flightPulseResult =
        tryAdapterMethodList(
        {
            "PulseTriggerGlide"
        },
        self,
        hostRuntime
    )
    if flightPulseResult ~= nil then
        hostRuntime.visualStateKey = "mounted_flight"
        return
    end

    tryCrossFadeAdapterStates(
        {
            "Fly",
            "Glide"
        },
        "mounted_flight"
    )
end

local function applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    if not hostRuntime.adapterHasNeutralIdleGlue and resolveAdapter() ~= nil then
        motionLogger:warnOnce(
            "adapter-neutral-idle-missing",
            "adapter is missing neutral idle glue; host keeps fallback idle state"
        )
    end
    local adapterIdleApplied = callAdapter("ApplyNeutralIdleDefaults", self, hostRuntime)
    if adapterCallSucceeded(adapterIdleApplied) then
        if applyGroundedIdleVisualState() ~= true then
            hostRuntime.visualStateKey = "grounded_idle"
        end
        return true
    end

    local adapterDefaultsApplied = callAdapter("ApplyDefaults", self, hostRuntime)
    if adapterCallSucceeded(adapterDefaultsApplied) then
        if applyGroundedIdleVisualState() ~= true then
            hostRuntime.visualStateKey = "grounded_idle"
        end
        return true
    end

    return applyGroundedIdleVisualState()
end

local function ensureNeutralIdleBootstrap()
    if hostRuntime.isMounted or hostRuntime.visualStateKey == "grounded_idle" then
        return
    end
    applyBindingFacts()
    applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
end

local function updateMountedMotion(dt)
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        return
    end
    if not hostRuntime.adapterHasMountedGlue and resolveAdapter() ~= nil then
        motionLogger:warnOnce(
            "adapter-mounted-glue-missing",
            "adapter is missing mounted locomotion glue; mounted motion will stay host-minimal"
        )
    end

    local forwardIntent = resolveForwardIntent()
    local result =
        callAdapter(
        "OnMountedInput",
        self,
        hostRuntime,
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
        hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
        forwardIntent,
        hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent,
        hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent
    )

    if result == nil then
        result =
            callAdapter(
            "ApplyMountedLocomotion",
            self,
            hostRuntime,
            hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
            hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
            forwardIntent,
            hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent,
            hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent
        )
    end

    if result == nil and controlProfile ~= "land" then
        if controlProfile == "fish" then
            motionLogger:warnOnce(
                "fish-fallback",
                "fish profile is retaining fish semantics while reusing flying-style mounted locomotion glue"
            )
        end
        -- `flying` / `fish` vertical intent is still retained on the host even when
        -- the current adapter only consumes move/turn/forward.
        callAdapter(
            "ApplyMountedLocomotion",
            self,
            hostRuntime,
            hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode,
            hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent,
            forwardIntent
        )
    end

    local currentTransform = self and self.transform or nil
    if currentTransform ~= nil and dt ~= nil and dt > 0 then
        ensureFacingCalibration(currentTransform, false)
        local turnValue = tonumber(hostRuntime.mountedTurnIntent) or 0
        local yawDelta = turnValue * (hostRuntime.turnSpeed or turnSpeed or 0) * dt
        if math.abs(yawDelta) > 0.0001 then
            local euler = currentTransform.eulerAngles
            currentTransform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(euler.x, euler.y + yawDelta, euler.z)
            hostRuntime.facingForward =
                rotateHorizontal(hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(currentTransform), yawDelta)
        end

        local forwardValue = resolveForwardIntent()
        if controlProfile == "land" then
            enforceMountedRigidBodySettings()

            local moveSpeed = hostRuntime.defaultMoveSpeed or defaultMoveSpeed
            if hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode == "run" then
                moveSpeed = hostRuntime.defaultRunSpeed or defaultRunSpeed
            end
            if forwardValue < 0 then
                moveSpeed = moveSpeed * 0.6
            end

            local forwardDistance = forwardValue * moveSpeed * dt
            local currentPosition = currentTransform.position
            local horizontalForward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(currentTransform)
            local candidatePosition =
                Vector3(
                currentPosition.x + horizontalForward.x * forwardDistance,
                currentPosition.y,
                currentPosition.z + horizontalForward.z * forwardDistance
            )
            local shouldWarnOnMiss =
                math.abs(forwardDistance) > 0.0001 or math.abs(turnValue) > 0.0001 or hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent
            local groundedPosition, groundHit =
                resolveGroundedPose(currentTransform, candidatePosition, dt, false, false, shouldWarnOnMiss)
            currentTransform.position = groundedPosition
            if groundHit ~= nil then

            end
        elseif controlProfile == "flying" or controlProfile == "fish" then
            local verticalDistance = 0
            local verticalIntent = tonumber(hostRuntime.mountedVerticalIntent) or 0
            if verticalIntent > 0 then
                verticalDistance = (hostRuntime.ascendSpeed or ascendSpeed) * math.min(verticalIntent, 1) * dt
            elseif verticalIntent < 0 then
                verticalDistance =
                    -(hostRuntime.descendSpeed or descendSpeed) * math.min(math.abs(verticalIntent), 1) * dt
            end

            local moveSpeed = hostRuntime.defaultMoveSpeed or defaultMoveSpeed
            local forwardDistance = forwardValue * moveSpeed * dt
            local descentBlockedByGround = false

                local currentPosition = currentTransform.position
                local forward = currentTransform.forward
                local up = currentTransform.up
                local candidatePosition =
                    Vector3(
                    currentPosition.x + forward.x * forwardDistance + up.x * verticalDistance,
                    currentPosition.y + forward.y * forwardDistance + up.y * verticalDistance,
                    currentPosition.z + forward.z * forwardDistance + up.z * verticalDistance
                )
                candidatePosition, descentBlockedByGround =
                    clampMountedAirborneDescent(currentTransform, currentPosition, candidatePosition, verticalIntent)
                currentTransform.position = candidatePosition
            end

            local currentHeight = currentTransform.position.y
            local baseHeight = hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight
            if baseHeight == nil then
                baseHeight = currentHeight
                hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight = currentHeight
            end
            local effectiveVerticalIntent = verticalIntent
            if descentBlockedByGround and effectiveVerticalIntent < 0 then
                effectiveVerticalIntent = 0
            end
            local airborneNow =
                math.abs(effectiveVerticalIntent) > 0.08 or currentHeight > baseHeight + 0.18 or
                (hostRuntime.mountedAirborne and currentHeight > baseHeight + 0.05)
            if airborneNow then
                applyMountedFlightVisualState(not hostRuntime.mountedAirborne)
            elseif hostRuntime.mountedAirborne then
                tryAdapterMethodList(
                    {
                        "PulseTriggerLandingGrounded",
                        "PulseTriggerLandingBranch"
                    },
                    self,
                    hostRuntime
                )
                hostRuntime.visualStateKey = nil
                hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = false
                applyGroundedIdleVisualState()
            end
            hostRuntime.mountedAirborne = airborneNow
        end
    end

    hostRuntime.mountedJumpIntent = false

-- Animated creature grounding companion.
-- Owns facing calibration, terrain sampling, grounded pose resolution, and scripted Rigidbody stabilization.
---@displayName 生物贴地

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = UnityEngine.Time
local Physics = UnityEngine.Physics
local Mathf = UnityEngine.Mathf
local Quaternion = UnityEngine.Quaternion
local Vector3 = UnityEngine.Vector3
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local motionLogger = Logger.create("animated-creature-grounding")

-- BEGIN TEMPLATE CONFIG
local facingMismatchAngleThreshold = 20
-- END TEMPLATE CONFIG

local hostRuntime = {}

local function bindHostRuntime(runtime)
    if
        type(runtime) ~= "table" or
            (runtime.controlProfile ~= "land" and runtime.controlProfile ~= "flying" and runtime.controlProfile ~= "fish") or
            tonumber(runtime.groundProbeDistance) == nil or tonumber(runtime.groundProbeUpDistance) == nil or
            tonumber(runtime.groundContactOffset) == nil
     then
        return false
    end
    hostRuntime = runtime
    return true
end

local function getGroundProbeUpDistance()
    return math.max(0.01, tonumber(hostRuntime.groundProbeUpDistance))
end

local function getGroundProbeDownDistance()
    return math.max(0.01, tonumber(hostRuntime.groundProbeDistance))
end

local function getGroundSnapSpeed()
    return 8.0
end

local function getGroundWarnCooldown()
    return 1.0
end

local function getMountedGroundContactThreshold()
    return 0.18
end

local function normalizeOrUp(vec)
    if vec == nil then
        return Vector3.up
    end
    if vec.sqrMagnitude == nil or vec.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        return Vector3.up
    end
    return vec.normalized
end

local function findFirstByNameToken(parent, token)
    if parent == nil or token == nil or token == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local lowerToken = string.lower(token)
    local selfName = string.lower(tostring(parent.name or ""))
    if string.find(selfName, lowerToken, 1, true) ~= nil then
        return parent
    end
    for i = 0, parent.childCount - 1 do
        local child = parent:GetChild(i)
        if child ~= nil then
            local found = findFirstByNameToken(child, token)
            if found ~= nil then
                return found
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function getHorizontalForward(root)
    local forward = root and root.forward or Vector3.forward
    local horizontal = Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
    if horizontal.sqrMagnitude == nil or horizontal.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        return Vector3.forward
    end
    return horizontal.normalized
end

local function getPelvisNode(root)
    if hostRuntime.pelvisNode ~= nil then
        return hostRuntime.pelvisNode
    end
    if root == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local direct = findFirstByNameToken(root, "pelvis")
    hostRuntime.pelvisNode = direct
    return hostRuntime.pelvisNode
end

local function getHeadNode(root)
    if hostRuntime.headNode ~= nil then
        return hostRuntime.headNode
    end
    if root == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local direct = findFirstByNameToken(root, "head")
    hostRuntime.headNode = direct
    return hostRuntime.headNode
end

local function getAnatomicalForward(root)
    local pelvis = getPelvisNode(root)
    local head = getHeadNode(root)
    if pelvis ~= nil and head ~= nil and pelvis.position ~= nil and head.position ~= nil then
        local forward = Vector3(head.position.x - pelvis.position.x, 0, head.position.z - pelvis.position.z)
        if forward.sqrMagnitude ~= nil and forward.sqrMagnitude >= 0.0001 then
            return forward.normalized
        end
    end
    return getHorizontalForward(root)
end

local function signedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
    local from = Vector3(fromVec.x, 0, fromVec.z)
    local to = Vector3(toVec.x, 0, toVec.z)
    if from.sqrMagnitude == nil or from.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        from = Vector3.forward
    else
        from = from.normalized
    end
    if to.sqrMagnitude == nil or to.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        to = Vector3.forward
    else
        to = to.normalized
    end
    local cross = from.x * to.z - from.z * to.x
    local dot = Mathf.Clamp(from.x * to.x + from.z * to.z, -1.0, 1.0)
    local angleRadians = nil
    local ok, result =
        pcall(
        function()
            return math.atan(cross, dot)
        end
    )
    if ok then
        angleRadians = result
    else
        angleRadians = math.atan(cross / math.max(math.abs(dot), 0.0001))
        if dot < 0 then
            if cross >= 0 then
                angleRadians = angleRadians + math.pi
            else
                angleRadians = angleRadians - math.pi
            end
        end
    end
    return math.deg(angleRadians)
end

local function rotateHorizontal(vector, yawDegrees)
    local radians = math.rad(yawDegrees)
    local cosValue = math.cos(radians)
    local sinValue = math.sin(radians)
    local x = vector.x * cosValue + vector.z * sinValue
    local z = (-vector.x) * sinValue + vector.z * cosValue
    local rotated = Vector3(x, 0, z)
    if rotated.sqrMagnitude == nil or rotated.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        return Vector3.forward
    end
    return rotated.normalized
end

local function ensureFacingCalibration(root, forceRefresh)
    if root == nil then
        hostRuntime.hasFacingMismatch = false
        hostRuntime.facingOffsetDegrees = 0.0
        hostRuntime.facingForward = Vector3.forward
        return hostRuntime.facingForward
    end

    if forceRefresh or hostRuntime.restAnatomicalForward == nil or hostRuntime.restRootForward == nil then
        hostRuntime.pelvisNode = nil
        hostRuntime.headNode = nil
        hostRuntime.restAnatomicalForward = getAnatomicalForward(root)
        hostRuntime.restRootForward = getHorizontalForward(root)
        local mismatchAngle = signedYawDegrees(hostRuntime.restRootForward, hostRuntime.restAnatomicalForward)
        hostRuntime.hasFacingMismatch = math.abs(mismatchAngle) >= (tonumber(facingMismatchAngleThreshold) or 20.0)
        hostRuntime.facingOffsetDegrees = hostRuntime.hasFacingMismatch and mismatchAngle or 0.0
        hostRuntime.facingForward =
            hostRuntime.hasFacingMismatch and hostRuntime.restAnatomicalForward or hostRuntime.restRootForward
        return hostRuntime.facingForward
    end

    if hostRuntime.facingForward == nil then
        hostRuntime.facingForward =
            hostRuntime.hasFacingMismatch and (hostRuntime.restAnatomicalForward or getAnatomicalForward(root)) or
            (hostRuntime.restRootForward or getHorizontalForward(root))
    end
    return hostRuntime.facingForward
end

local function warnMissingGround(message)
    local now = Time.time or 0.0
    if now - hostRuntime.lastGroundWarnTime < getGroundWarnCooldown() then
        return
    end
    hostRuntime.lastGroundWarnTime = now
    motionLogger:warn(message)
end

local function clearGroundingState()
    hostRuntime.grounded = false
    hostRuntime.groundOffset = nil
    hostRuntime.lastGroundHeight = nil
    hostRuntime.lastGroundNormal = nil
    hostRuntime.lastGroundedPosition = nil
    hostRuntime.lastGroundWarnTime = -1000.0
    hostRuntime.hasResolvedGroundOnce = false
end

local function enforceMountedRigidBodySettings()
    if hostRuntime.rb == nil then
        return
    end
    if hostRuntime.rb.useGravity == true and hostRuntime.hasStarted then
        motionLogger:warnOnce(
            "mounted-rigidbody-gravity-enabled",
            tostring(hostRuntime.controlProfile) ..
                " mounted animated creature root rigidBody should keep useGravity disabled; overriding to preserve scripted motion"
        )
    end
    hostRuntime.rb.isKinematic = true
    hostRuntime.rb.useGravity = false
end

local function isSelfCollider(root, collider)
    if root == nil or collider == nil or collider.transform == nil then
        return false
    end
    return collider.transform.root == root.root
end

local function isMountedRiderCollider(collider)
    if collider == nil or collider.transform == nil or hostRuntime.mountedRider == nil then
        return false
    end
    if hostRuntime.mountedRider.gameObject == nil or hostRuntime.mountedRider.gameObject.transform == nil then
        return false
    end
    return collider.transform.root == hostRuntime.mountedRider.gameObject.transform.root
end

local function shouldIgnoreGroundCollider(root, collider)
    if collider == nil then
        return true
    end
    if collider.isTrigger then
        return true
    end
    if isSelfCollider(root, collider) then
        return true
    end
    if isMountedRiderCollider(collider) then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function getRaycastHitAt(hits, index)
    if hits == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local hit = hits[index]
    if hit ~= nil then
        return hit
    end

    if type(hits.GetValue) == "function" then
        local ok, value =
            pcall(
            function()
                return hits:GetValue(index)
            end
        )
        if ok then
            return value
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function sampleGroundAt(root, worldPosition)
    if root == nil or worldPosition == nil or Physics == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local origin = Vector3(worldPosition.x, worldPosition.y + getGroundProbeUpDistance(), worldPosition.z)
    local maxDistance = getGroundProbeUpDistance() + getGroundProbeDownDistance()
    local hits = Physics.RaycastAll(origin, Vector3.down, maxDistance)
    if hits == nil or hits.Length == nil or hits.Length <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local best = nil
    local bestDistance = nil
    for i = 0, hits.Length - 1 do
        local hit = getRaycastHitAt(hits, i)
        if hit ~= nil then
            local collider = hit.collider
            if collider ~= nil and not shouldIgnoreGroundCollider(root, collider) then
                local hitDistance = tonumber(hit.distance) or 0.0
                if best == nil or hitDistance < bestDistance then
                    best = hit
                    bestDistance = hitDistance
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if best == nil then
        return nil
    end

    return {
        point = best.point,
        normal = normalizeOrUp(best.normal),

        collider = best.collider

local function ensureGroundOffset(root, groundHit, forceResetOffset)
    if root == nil or groundHit == nil or groundHit.point == nil then
        return hostRuntime.groundOffset
    end

    -- the (possibly airborne) spawn-time height differential. The contact offset
    -- accounts for pivot-to-foot distance and is authored per rig, defaulting to 0.
    if hostRuntime.controlProfile == "land" then
        hostRuntime.groundOffset = tonumber(hostRuntime.groundContactOffset)
        return hostRuntime.groundOffset
    end

    if forceResetOffset or hostRuntime.groundOffset == nil then
        hostRuntime.groundOffset = root.position.y - groundHit.point.y
    end

    return hostRuntime.groundOffset
end

local function applyGroundAlignedRotation(root, targetNormal, deltaTime)
    if root == nil then
        return

    local limitedNormal = normalizeOrUp(targetNormal)
    local heading =
        hostRuntime.facingForward or
        (hostRuntime.hasFacingMismatch and (hostRuntime.restAnatomicalForward or getAnatomicalForward(root)) or
            getHorizontalForward(root))
    local rootForward =
        hostRuntime.hasFacingMismatch and rotateHorizontal(heading, hostRuntime.facingOffsetDegrees or 0.0) or heading
    local forward = Vector3.ProjectOnPlane(rootForward, limitedNormal)
    if forward.sqrMagnitude == nil or forward.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        forward = Vector3.ProjectOnPlane(Vector3.forward, limitedNormal)
    end
    if forward.sqrMagnitude == nil or forward.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001 then
        return
    end

    local targetRotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(forward.normalized, limitedNormal)
    local t = Mathf.Clamp01(getGroundSnapSpeed() * (deltaTime or 0.0))
    if t <= 0.0 then
        root.rotation = targetRotation
        return
    end

local function resolveGroundedPose(root, candidatePosition, deltaTime, forceResetOffset, immediateSnap, shouldWarnOnMiss)
    if root == nil or candidatePosition == nil then
        return candidatePosition, nil
    end

    local groundHit = sampleGroundAt(root, candidatePosition)
    if groundHit == nil then
        hostRuntime.grounded = false
        if shouldWarnOnMiss and hostRuntime.hasResolvedGroundOnce then
            warnMissingGround("ground probe missed; keeping current mounted height")

        return Vector3(candidatePosition.x, root.position.y, candidatePosition.z), nil
    end

    local offset = ensureGroundOffset(root, groundHit, forceResetOffset)
    local targetY = groundHit.point.y + (tonumber(offset) or 0.0)
    local currentY = root.position.y
    local snappedY = targetY
    if not immediateSnap then
        snappedY = Mathf.MoveTowards(currentY, targetY, getGroundSnapSpeed() * deltaTime)
    end

    hostRuntime.grounded = true
    hostRuntime.hasResolvedGroundOnce = true
    hostRuntime.lastGroundHeight = targetY
    hostRuntime.lastGroundNormal = groundHit.normal

    end

    applyGroundAlignedRotation(root, groundHit.normal, dt or 0.0)
    return true

local function clampMountedAirborneDescent(root, currentPosition, candidatePosition, verticalIntent)
    if root == nil or currentPosition == nil or candidatePosition == nil then
        return candidatePosition, false
    end
    if tonumber(verticalIntent) == nil or tonumber(verticalIntent) >= 0 then
        return candidatePosition, false
    end

    local probePosition =
        Vector3(candidatePosition.x, math.max(currentPosition.y, candidatePosition.y), candidatePosition.z)
    local groundHit = sampleGroundAt(root, probePosition)
    if groundHit == nil or groundHit.point == nil then
        return candidatePosition, false
    end

    local contactThreshold = getMountedGroundContactThreshold()
    local currentClearance = currentPosition.y - groundHit.point.y
    local candidateClearance = candidatePosition.y - groundHit.point.y
    local storedClearance = tonumber(hostRuntime.mountedGroundClearance)

    if storedClearance == nil and currentClearance <= contactThreshold then
        storedClearance = math.max(currentClearance, 0.0)
        hostRuntime.mountedGroundClearance = storedClearance
    end
    if storedClearance == nil and candidateClearance <= contactThreshold then
        storedClearance = math.max(candidateClearance, 0.0)
        hostRuntime.mountedGroundClearance = storedClearance
    end

    local minimumHeight = groundHit.point.y + math.max(storedClearance or 0.0, 0.0)
    if candidatePosition.y >= minimumHeight then
        return candidatePosition, false
    end

    return Vector3(candidatePosition.x, minimumHeight, candidatePosition.z), true

    end

    if not bindHostRuntime(runtime) then

    return true
end

function ClampRigAirborneDescent(runtime, root, currentPosition, candidatePosition, verticalIntent)
    if not bindHostRuntime(runtime) then
        return candidatePosition, false
    end
    return clampMountedAirborneDescent(root, currentPosition, candidatePosition, verticalIntent)
end

-- BEGIN WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING
-- Ambient sheep behaviour: slow wandering, grazing pauses and stepping away from nearby players.
-- The animator supplies leg, body and head motion; this block only steers the root and picks states.
local DouyinActorService = CS.DouyinActorService

local SHEEP_WALK_SPEED = 0.65
local SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED = 1.35
local SHEEP_TURN_SPEED = 70
local SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED = 110
local SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS = 2.2
local SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS = 5.5
local SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS = 4.5
local SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE = 0.4
local EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_L"
local EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_R"
local TAIL_PIVOT_PATH = "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Tail/SHEEP_ Tail1/SHEEP_ Tail2/TailPivot"

local sheep = {
    ready = false,
    mode = "idle",
    moveMode = nil,
    modeTimer = 0,
    idleActionTimer = 0,
    walkTimer = 0,
    fleeTimer = 0,
    noticeTimer = 0,
    ownershipTimer = 0,
    isOwner = true,
    home = nil,
    walkTarget = nil,
    threatActor = nil,
    threatDistance = nil,
    swayTime = 0,
    earLeft = nil,
    earRight = nil,
    tailPivot = nil,
    earLeftEuler = nil,
    earRightEuler = nil,
    tailEuler = nil,
    warnedSwayNodes = false,
    lastObservedPosition = nil,
}

local function sheepRandom(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

-- atan2 kept explicit so the script does not depend on a two-argument math.atan.
local function sheepAtan2(y, x)
    if x > 0 then
        return math.atan(y / x)
    end
    if x < 0 then
        if y >= 0 then
            return math.atan(y / x) + math.pi
        end
        return math.atan(y / x) - math.pi
    end
    if y > 0 then
        return math.pi * 0.5
    end
    if y < 0 then
        return -math.pi * 0.5
    end
    return 0
end

local function sheepSignedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
    local fromLength = math.sqrt(fromVec.x * fromVec.x + fromVec.z * fromVec.z)
    local toLength = math.sqrt(toVec.x * toVec.x + toVec.z * toVec.z)
    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
        return 0
    end
    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))
end

local function sheepApplyMoveMode(mode)
    if sheep.moveMode == mode then
        return
    end
    sheep.moveMode = mode
    if mode == "idle" then
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    else
        callAdapter("SetMoveMode", self, hostRuntime, mode)
    end
end

local function sheepFindNode(relativePath)
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local node = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(relativePath)
    if node ~= nil then
        return node
    end
    return runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("rig/" .. relativePath)
end

local function sheepBindSwayNodes()
    sheep.earLeft = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH)
    sheep.earRight = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH)
    sheep.tailPivot = sheepFindNode(TAIL_PIVOT_PATH)
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil then
        sheep.earLeftEuler = sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil then
        sheep.earRightEuler = sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil then
        sheep.tailEuler = sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earLeft == nil and sheep.earRight == nil and sheep.tailPivot == nil and not sheep.warnedSwayNodes then
        sheep.warnedSwayNodes = true
        motionLogger:warnOnce("sheep-sway-nodes-missing", "sheep ear/tail pivots not found; sway animation skipped")
    end
end

local function sheepApplySway()
    local time = sheep.swayTime
    local earAngle = math.sin(time * 2.2) * 3.0
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil and sheep.earLeftEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earLeftEuler
        sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil and sheep.earRightEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earRightEuler
        sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y - earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil and sheep.tailEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.tailEuler
        sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + math.sin(time * 1.7 + 0.6) * 4.0, base.z)
    end
end

local function sheepCanDrive()
    local ok, owned = pcall(
        function()
            return self:HasOwnership()
        end
    )
    if not ok or owned == true then
        return true
    end
    local ownerOk, owner = pcall(
        function()
            return self:GetOwner()
        end
    )
    if ownerOk and owner == nil then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    local actors = DouyinActorService.GetActors()
    local count = 0
    if actors ~= nil and actors.Length ~= nil then
        count = actors.Length
    end
    local nearestActor = nil
    local nearestDistance = nil
    for index = 1, count do
        local actor = actors[index]
        if actor == nil then
            actor = actors[index - 1]
        end
        if actor ~= nil and actor.isPet ~= true then
            local position = actor.position
            if position ~= nil then
                local dx = position.x - root.position.x
                local dz = position.z - root.position.z
                local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                if nearestDistance == nil or distance < nearestDistance then
                    nearestDistance = distance
                    nearestActor = actor
                end
            end
        end
    end
    sheep.threatActor = nearestActor
    sheep.threatDistance = nearestDistance
end

local function sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, turnSpeed)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local yaw = sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction)
    local maxTurn = turnSpeed * dt
    if yaw > maxTurn then
        yaw = maxTurn
    elseif yaw < -maxTurn then
        yaw = -maxTurn
    end
    if math.abs(yaw) > 0.0001 then
        hostRuntime.facingForward = rotateHorizontal(forward, yaw)
    else
        hostRuntime.facingForward = forward
    end
end

local function sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local position = root.position
    root.position = Vector3(position.x + forward.x * speed * dt, position.y, position.z + forward.z * speed * dt)
end

local function sheepPulseIdleAction()
    local roll = math.random()
    if roll < 0.5 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleGraze", self, hostRuntime)
    elseif roll < 0.75 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleChew", self, hostRuntime)
    elseif roll < 0.92 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleLookAround", self, hostRuntime)
    else
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleBaaa", self, hostRuntime)
    end
end

local function sheepEnterIdle()
    sheep.mode = "idle"
    sheep.modeTimer = sheepRandom(4.0, 8.0)
    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.5, 1.6)
    sheep.walkTarget = nil
    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleGraze", self, hostRuntime)
end

local function sheepEnterWalk(root)
    local home = sheep.home or root.position
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local radius = sheepRandom(1.2, SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS)
    sheep.walkTarget = Vector3(home.x + math.cos(angle) * radius, home.y, home.z + math.sin(angle) * radius)
    sheep.walkTimer = 0
    sheep.mode = "walk"
    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
end

local function sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    sheep.modeTimer = sheep.modeTimer - dt
    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheep.idleActionTimer - dt
    if sheep.idleActionTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(2.2, 4.8)
        sheepPulseIdleAction()
    end
    if sheep.modeTimer <= 0 then
        local root = self and self.transform or nil
        if root ~= nil then
            sheepEnterWalk(root)
        end
    end
end

local function sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    local target = sheep.walkTarget
    if target == nil then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    sheep.walkTimer = sheep.walkTimer + dt
    local dx = target.x - root.position.x
    local dz = target.z - root.position.z
    local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
    if distance <= SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE or sheep.walkTimer >= 9.0 then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    local direction = Vector3(dx / distance, 0, dz / distance)
    sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, SHEEP_TURN_SPEED)
    local speed = SHEEP_WALK_SPEED * math.max(0.25, math.min(1, distance / 1.2))
    sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
end

local function sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    sheep.fleeTimer = sheep.fleeTimer + dt
    local actor = sheep.threatActor
    local awayX = 0
    local awayZ = 0
    if actor ~= nil and actor.position ~= nil then
        awayX = root.position.x - actor.position.x
        awayZ = root.position.z - actor.position.z
    end
    local length = math.sqrt(awayX * awayX + awayZ * awayZ)
    if length < 0.0001 then

        awayZ = -forward.z

local function sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
    local previous = sheep.lastObservedPosition

        local dz = root.position.z - previous.z

    if root == nil then

+local function sheepRandom(minValue, maxValue)
+    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
+end
+
+-- atan2 kept explicit so the script does not depend on a two-argument math.atan.
+local function sheepAtan2(y, x)
+    if x > 0 then
+        return math.atan(y / x)
+    end
+    if x < 0 then
+        if y >= 0 then
+            return math.atan(y / x) + math.pi
+        end
+        return math.atan(y / x) - math.pi
+    end
+    if y > 0 then
+        return math.pi * 0.5
+    end
+    if y < 0 then
+        return -math.pi * 0.5
+    end
+    return 0
+end
+
+local function sheepSignedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
+    local fromLength = math.sqrt(fromVec.x * fromVec.x + fromVec.z * fromVec.z)
+    local toLength = math.sqrt(toVec.x * toVec.x + toVec.z * toVec.z)
+    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
+        return 0
+    end
+    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
+    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
+    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
+    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
+    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
+    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
+    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
+    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))
+end

+    if sheep.moveMode == mode then
+        return
+    end
+    sheep.moveMode = mode
+    if mode == "idle" then
+        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
+    else
+        callAdapter("SetMoveMode", self, hostRuntime, mode)
+    end
+end
+
+local function sheepFindNode(relativePath)
+    if runtimeScope == nil then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local node = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(relativePath)
+    if node ~= nil then
+        return node
+    end
+    return runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("rig/" .. relativePath)
+end
+
+local function sheepBindSwayNodes()
+    sheep.earLeft = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH)
+    sheep.earRight = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH)
+    sheep.tailPivot = sheepFindNode(TAIL_PIVOT_PATH)
+    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil then
+        sheep.earLeftEuler = sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles
+    end
+    if sheep.earRight ~= nil then
+        sheep.earRightEuler = sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles
+    end
+    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil then
+        sheep.tailEuler = sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles
+    end
+    if sheep.earLeft == nil and sheep.earRight == nil and sheep.tailPivot == nil and not sheep.warnedSwayNodes then
+        sheep.warnedSwayNodes = true
+        motionLogger:warnOnce("sheep-sway-nodes-missing", "sheep ear/tail pivots not found; sway animation skipped")
+    end
+end
+
+local function sheepApplySway()
+    local time = sheep.swayTime
+    local earAngle = math.sin(time * 2.2) * 3.0
+    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil and sheep.earLeftEuler ~= nil then
+        local base = sheep.earLeftEuler
+        sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + earAngle, base.z)
+    end
+    if sheep.earRight ~= nil and sheep.earRightEuler ~= nil then
+        local base = sheep.earRightEuler
+        sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y - earAngle, base.z)
+    end
+    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil and sheep.tailEuler ~= nil then
+        local base = sheep.tailEuler
+        sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + math.sin(time * 1.7 + 0.6) * 4.0, base.z)

+    local dz = target.z - root.position.z

+        return
+    end

+end

+    local awayZ = 0

+        awayZ = root.position.z - actor.position.z
+    end
+    local length = math.sqrt(awayX * awayX + awayZ * awayZ)
+    if length < 0.0001 then
+        local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
+        awayX = -forward.x
+        awayZ = -forward.z
+        length = 1
+    end
+    local direction = Vector3(awayX / length, 0, awayZ / length)
+    sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED)
+    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
+    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or direction
+    local remainingTurn = math.abs(sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction))
+    local speed = SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED * math.max(0, 1 - remainingTurn / 100)
+    if speed > 0.02 then
+        sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
+    end
+    local farEnough = sheep.threatDistance == nil or sheep.threatDistance >= SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS
+    if (farEnough and sheep.fleeTimer >= 1.2) or sheep.fleeTimer >= 5.0 then
+        sheepEnterIdle()
+    end
+end

+local function sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
+    local previous = sheep.lastObservedPosition
+    local speed = 0

+        local dz = root.position.z - previous.z

+    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
+    if speed > 1.1 then
+        sheepApplyMoveMode("run")
+    elseif speed > 0.08 then

+    else

+    end
+end

+local function updateSheepRoaming(dt)

+    end

+    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)

-- BEGIN WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING
-- Ambient sheep behaviour: slow wandering, grazing pauses and stepping away from nearby players.
-- The animator supplies leg, body and head motion; this block only steers the root and picks states.
local DouyinActorService = CS.DouyinActorService

local SHEEP_WALK_SPEED = 0.65
local SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED = 1.35
local SHEEP_TURN_SPEED = 70
local SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED = 110
local SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS = 2.2
local SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS = 5.5
local SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS = 4.5
local SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE = 0.4
local EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_L"
local EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_R"
local TAIL_PIVOT_PATH = "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Tail/SHEEP_ Tail1/SHEEP_ Tail2/TailPivot"

local sheep = {
    ready = false,
    mode = "idle",
    moveMode = nil,
    modeTimer = 0,
    idleActionTimer = 0,
    walkTimer = 0,
    fleeTimer = 0,
    noticeTimer = 0,
    ownershipTimer = 0,
    isOwner = true,
    home = nil,
    walkTarget = nil,
    threatActor = nil,
    threatDistance = nil,
    swayTime = 0,
    earLeft = nil,
    earRight = nil,
    tailPivot = nil,
    earLeftEuler = nil,
    earRightEuler = nil,
    tailEuler = nil,
    warnedSwayNodes = false,
    lastObservedPosition = nil,
}

local function sheepRandom(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

-- atan2 kept explicit so the script does not depend on a two-argument math.atan.
local function sheepAtan2(y, x)
    if x > 0 then
        return math.atan(y / x)
    end
    if x < 0 then
        if y >= 0 then
            return math.atan(y / x) + math.pi
        end
        return math.atan(y / x) - math.pi
    end
    if y > 0 then
        return math.pi * 0.5
    end
    if y < 0 then
        return -math.pi * 0.5
    end
    return 0
end

local function sheepSignedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
    local fromLength = math.sqrt(fromVec.x * fromVec.x + fromVec.z * fromVec.z)
    local toLength = math.sqrt(toVec.x * toVec.x + toVec.z * toVec.z)
    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
        return 0
    end
    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))
end

local function sheepApplyMoveMode(mode)
    if sheep.moveMode == mode then
        return
    end
    sheep.moveMode = mode
    if mode == "idle" then
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    else
        callAdapter("SetMoveMode", self, hostRuntime, mode)
    end
end

local function sheepFindNode(relativePath)
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local node = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(relativePath)
    if node ~= nil then
        return node
    end
    return runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("rig/" .. relativePath)
end

local function sheepBindSwayNodes()
    sheep.earLeft = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH)
    sheep.earRight = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH)
    sheep.tailPivot = sheepFindNode(TAIL_PIVOT_PATH)
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil then
        sheep.earLeftEuler = sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil then
        sheep.earRightEuler = sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil then
        sheep.tailEuler = sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earLeft == nil and sheep.earRight == nil and sheep.tailPivot == nil and not sheep.warnedSwayNodes then
        sheep.warnedSwayNodes = true
        motionLogger:warnOnce("sheep-sway-nodes-missing", "sheep ear/tail pivots not found; sway animation skipped")
    end
end

local function sheepApplySway()
    local time = sheep.swayTime
    local earAngle = math.sin(time * 2.2) * 3.0
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil and sheep.earLeftEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earLeftEuler
        sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil and sheep.earRightEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earRightEuler
        sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y - earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil and sheep.tailEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.tailEuler
        sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + math.sin(time * 1.7 + 0.6) * 4.0, base.z)
    end
end

local function sheepCanDrive()
    local ok, owned = pcall(
        function()
            return self:HasOwnership()
        end
    )
    if not ok or owned == true then
        return true
    end
    local ownerOk, owner = pcall(
        function()
            return self:GetOwner()
        end
    )
    if ownerOk and owner == nil then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    if DouyinActorService == nil then
        sheep.threatActor = nil
        sheep.threatDistance = nil
        return
    end
    local ok, actors = pcall(
        function()
            return DouyinActorService.GetActors()
        end
    )
    if not ok then
        sheep.threatActor = nil
        sheep.threatDistance = nil
        return
    end
    local count = 0
    if actors ~= nil and actors.Length ~= nil then
        count = actors.Length
    end
    local nearestActor = nil
    local nearestDistance = nil
    local nearestX = nil
    local nearestZ = nil
    for index = 1, count do
        local actor = actors[index]
        if actor == nil then
            actor = actors[index - 1]
        end
        if actor ~= nil and actor.isPet ~= true then
            local position = actor.position
            if position ~= nil then
                local dx = position.x - root.position.x
                local dz = position.z - root.position.z
                local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                if nearestDistance == nil or distance < nearestDistance then
                    nearestDistance = distance
                    nearestActor = actor
                    nearestX = position.x
                    nearestZ = position.z
                end
            end
        end
    end
    sheep.threatActor = nearestActor
    sheep.threatDistance = nearestDistance
    sheep.threatX = nearestX
    sheep.threatZ = nearestZ
end

local function sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, turnSpeed)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local yaw = sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction)
    local maxTurn = turnSpeed * dt
    if yaw > maxTurn then
        yaw = maxTurn
    elseif yaw < -maxTurn then
        yaw = -maxTurn
    end
    if math.abs(yaw) > 0.0001 then
        hostRuntime.facingForward = rotateHorizontal(forward, yaw)
    else
        hostRuntime.facingForward = forward
    end
end

local function sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local position = root.position
    root.position = Vector3(position.x + forward.x * speed * dt, position.y, position.z + forward.z * speed * dt)
end
