-- BEGIN WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING
-- Ambient sheep behaviour: slow wandering, grazing pauses and stepping away from nearby players.
-- The animator supplies leg, body and head motion; this block only steers the root and picks states.
local DouyinActorService = CS.DouyinActorService

local SHEEP_WALK_SPEED = 0.65
local SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED = 1.35
local SHEEP_TURN_SPEED = 70
local SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED = 110
local SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS = 2.2
local SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS = 5.5
local SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS = 4.5
local SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE = 0.4
local EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_L"
local EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_R"
local TAIL_PIVOT_PATH = "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Tail/SHEEP_ Tail1/SHEEP_ Tail2/TailPivot"

local sheep = {
    ready = false,
    mode = "idle",
    moveMode = nil,
    modeTimer = 0,
    idleActionTimer = 0,
    walkTimer = 0,
    fleeTimer = 0,
    noticeTimer = 0,
    ownershipTimer = 0,
    isOwner = true,
    home = nil,
    walkTarget = nil,
    threatActor = nil,
    threatDistance = nil,
    swayTime = 0,
    earLeft = nil,
    earRight = nil,
    tailPivot = nil,
    earLeftEuler = nil,
    earRightEuler = nil,
    tailEuler = nil,
    warnedSwayNodes = false,
    lastObservedPosition = nil,
}

local function sheepRandom(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

-- atan2 kept explicit so the script does not depend on a two-argument math.atan.
local function sheepAtan2(y, x)
    if x > 0 then
        return math.atan(y / x)
    end
    if x < 0 then
        if y >= 0 then
            return math.atan(y / x) + math.pi
        end
        return math.atan(y / x) - math.pi
    end
    if y > 0 then
        return math.pi * 0.5
    end
    if y < 0 then
        return -math.pi * 0.5
    end
    return 0
end

local function sheepSignedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
    local fromLength = math.sqrt(fromVec.x * fromVec.x + fromVec.z * fromVec.z)
    local toLength = math.sqrt(toVec.x * toVec.x + toVec.z * toVec.z)
    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
        return 0
    end
    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))
end

local function sheepApplyMoveMode(mode)
    if sheep.moveMode == mode then
        return
    end
    sheep.moveMode = mode
    if mode == "idle" then
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    else
        callAdapter("SetMoveMode", self, hostRuntime, mode)
    end
end

local function sheepFindNode(relativePath)
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local node = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(relativePath)
    if node ~= nil then
        return node
    end
    return runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("rig/" .. relativePath)
end

local function sheepBindSwayNodes()
    sheep.earLeft = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH)
    sheep.earRight = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH)
    sheep.tailPivot = sheepFindNode(TAIL_PIVOT_PATH)
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil then
        sheep.earLeftEuler = sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil then
        sheep.earRightEuler = sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil then
        sheep.tailEuler = sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earLeft == nil and sheep.earRight == nil and sheep.tailPivot == nil and not sheep.warnedSwayNodes then
        sheep.warnedSwayNodes = true
        motionLogger:warnOnce("sheep-sway-nodes-missing", "sheep ear/tail pivots not found; sway animation skipped")
    end
end

local function sheepApplySway()
    local time = sheep.swayTime
    local earAngle = math.sin(time * 2.2) * 3.0
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil and sheep.earLeftEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earLeftEuler
        sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil and sheep.earRightEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earRightEuler
        sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y - earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil and sheep.tailEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.tailEuler
        sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + math.sin(time * 1.7 + 0.6) * 4.0, base.z)
    end
end

local function sheepCanDrive()
    local ok, owned = pcall(
        function()
            return self:HasOwnership()
        end
    )
    if not ok or owned == true then
        return true
    end
    local ownerOk, owner = pcall(
        function()
            return self:GetOwner()
        end
    )
    if ownerOk and owner == nil then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    local actors = DouyinActorService.GetActors()
    local count = 0
    if actors ~= nil and actors.Length ~= nil then
        count = actors.Length
    end
    local nearestActor = nil
    local nearestDistance = nil
    for index = 1, count do
        local actor = actors[index]
        if actor == nil then
            actor = actors[index - 1]
        end
        if actor ~= nil and actor.isPet ~= true then
            local position = actor.position
            if position ~= nil then
                local dx = position.x - root.position.x
                local dz = position.z - root.position.z
                local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                if nearestDistance == nil or distance < nearestDistance then
                    nearestDistance = distance
                    nearestActor = actor
                end
            end
        end
    end
    sheep.threatActor = nearestActor
    sheep.threatDistance = nearestDistance
end

local function sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, turnSpeed)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local yaw = sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction)
    local maxTurn = turnSpeed * dt
    if yaw > maxTurn then
        yaw = maxTurn
    elseif yaw < -maxTurn then
        yaw = -maxTurn
    end
    if math.abs(yaw) > 0.0001 then
        hostRuntime.facingForward = rotateHorizontal(forward, yaw)
    else
        hostRuntime.facingForward = forward
    end
end

local function sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local position = root.position
    root.position = Vector3(position.x + forward.x * speed * dt, position.y, position.z + forward.z * speed * dt)
end

local function sheepPulseIdleAction()
    local roll = math.random()
    if roll < 0.5 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleGraze", self, hostRuntime)
    elseif roll < 0.75 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleChew", self, hostRuntime)
    elseif roll < 0.92 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleLookAround", self, hostRuntime)
    else
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleBaaa", self, hostRuntime)
    end
end

local function sheepEnterIdle()
    sheep.mode = "idle"
    sheep.modeTimer = sheepRandom(4.0, 8.0)
    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.5, 1.6)
    sheep.walkTarget = nil
    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleGraze", self, hostRuntime)
end

local function sheepEnterWalk(root)
    local home = sheep.home or root.position
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local radius = sheepRandom(1.2, SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS)
    sheep.walkTarget = Vector3(home.x + math.cos(angle) * radius, home.y, home.z + math.sin(angle) * radius)
    sheep.walkTimer = 0
    sheep.mode = "walk"
    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
end

local function sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    sheep.modeTimer = sheep.modeTimer - dt
    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheep.idleActionTimer - dt
    if sheep.idleActionTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(2.2, 4.8)
        sheepPulseIdleAction()
    end
    if sheep.modeTimer <= 0 then
        local root = self and self.transform or nil
        if root ~= nil then
            sheepEnterWalk(root)
        end
    end
end

local function sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    local target = sheep.walkTarget
    if target == nil then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    sheep.walkTimer = sheep.walkTimer + dt
    local dx = target.x - root.position.x
    local dz = target.z - root.position.z
    local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
    if distance <= SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE or sheep.walkTimer >= 9.0 then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    local direction = Vector3(dx / distance, 0, dz / distance)
    sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, SHEEP_TURN_SPEED)
    local speed = SHEEP_WALK_SPEED * math.max(0.25, math.min(1, distance / 1.2))
    sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
end

local function sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    sheep.fleeTimer = sheep.fleeTimer + dt
    local actor = sheep.threatActor
    local awayX = 0
    local awayZ = 0
    if actor ~= nil and actor.position ~= nil then
        awayX = root.position.x - actor.position.x
        awayZ = root.position.z - actor.position.z
    end
    local length = math.sqrt(awayX * awayX + awayZ * awayZ)
    if length < 0.0001 then
        local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
        awayX = -forward.x
        awayZ = -forward.z
        length = 1
    end
    local direction = Vector3(awayX / length, 0, awayZ / length)
    sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED)
    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or direction
    local remainingTurn = math.abs(sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction))
    local speed = SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED * math.max(0, 1 - remainingTurn / 100)
    if speed > 0.02 then
        sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    end
    local farEnough = sheep.threatDistance == nil or sheep.threatDistance >= SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS
    if (farEnough and sheep.fleeTimer >= 1.2) or sheep.fleeTimer >= 5.0 then
        sheepEnterIdle()
    end
end

local function sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
    local previous = sheep.lastObservedPosition
    local speed = 0
    if previous ~= nil and dt > 0.0001 then
        local dx = root.position.x - previous.x
        local dz = root.position.z - previous.z
        speed = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) / dt
    end
    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
    if speed > 1.1 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("run")
    elseif speed > 0.08 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    else
        sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    end
end

local function updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    local root = self and self.transform or nil
    if root == nil then
        return
    end

    if not sheep.ready then
        sheep.ready = true
        sheep.home = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.modeTimer = sheepRandom(2.5, 5.0)
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.8, 2.0)
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
        ensureFacingCalibration(root, true)
        sheepBindSwayNodes()
    end

    sheep.swayTime = sheep.swayTime + dt
    sheepApplySway()

    sheep.ownershipTimer = sheep.ownershipTimer - dt
    if sheep.ownershipTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
    end

    if not sheep.isOwner then
        sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
        return
    end

    sheep.noticeTimer = sheep.noticeTimer - dt
    if sheep.noticeTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.noticeTimer = 0.2
        sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    end

    if sheep.threatDistance ~= nil and sheep.threatDistance <= SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS and sheep.mode ~= "flee" then
        sheep.mode = "flee"
        sheep.fleeTimer = 0
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    end

    if sheep.mode == "flee" then
        sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    elseif sheep.mode == "walk" then
        sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    else
        sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    end

    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
end
-- END WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING

local function updateAutonomousMotion(dt)
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    end
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted and controlProfile == "land" then
        refreshUnmountedGroundingInternal(dt)
    end

-- BEGIN WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING
-- Ambient sheep behaviour: slow wandering, grazing pauses and stepping away from nearby players.
-- The animator supplies leg, body and head motion; this block only steers the root and picks states.
local DouyinActorService = CS.DouyinActorService

local SHEEP_WALK_SPEED = 0.65
local SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED = 1.35
local SHEEP_TURN_SPEED = 70
local SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED = 110
local SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS = 2.2
local SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS = 5.5
local SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS = 4.5
local SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE = 0.4
local EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_L"
local EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_R"
local TAIL_PIVOT_PATH = "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Tail/SHEEP_ Tail1/SHEEP_ Tail2/TailPivot"

local sheep = {
    ready = false,
    mode = "idle",
    moveMode = nil,
    modeTimer = 0,
    idleActionTimer = 0,
    walkTimer = 0,
    fleeTimer = 0,
    noticeTimer = 0,
    ownershipTimer = 0,
    isOwner = true,
    home = nil,
    walkTarget = nil,
    threatActor = nil,
    threatDistance = nil,
    swayTime = 0,
    earLeft = nil,
    earRight = nil,
    tailPivot = nil,
    earLeftEuler = nil,
    earRightEuler = nil,
    tailEuler = nil,
    warnedSwayNodes = false,
    lastObservedPosition = nil,
}

local function sheepRandom(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

-- atan2 kept explicit so the script does not depend on a two-argument math.atan.
local function sheepAtan2(y, x)
    if x > 0 then
        return math.atan(y / x)
    end
    if x < 0 then
        if y >= 0 then
            return math.atan(y / x) + math.pi
        end
        return math.atan(y / x) - math.pi
    end
    if y > 0 then
        return math.pi * 0.5
    end
    if y < 0 then
        return -math.pi * 0.5
    end
    return 0
end

local function sheepSignedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
    local fromLength = math.sqrt(fromVec.x * fromVec.x + fromVec.z * fromVec.z)
    local toLength = math.sqrt(toVec.x * toVec.x + toVec.z * toVec.z)
    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
        return 0
    end
    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))
end

local function sheepApplyMoveMode(mode)
    if sheep.moveMode == mode then
        return
    end
    sheep.moveMode = mode
    if mode == "idle" then
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    else
        callAdapter("SetMoveMode", self, hostRuntime, mode)
    end
end

local function sheepFindNode(relativePath)
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local node = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(relativePath)
    if node ~= nil then
        return node
    end
    return runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("rig/" .. relativePath)
end

local function sheepBindSwayNodes()
    sheep.earLeft = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH)
    sheep.earRight = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH)
    sheep.tailPivot = sheepFindNode(TAIL_PIVOT_PATH)
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil then
        sheep.earLeftEuler = sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil then
        sheep.earRightEuler = sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil then
        sheep.tailEuler = sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earLeft == nil and sheep.earRight == nil and sheep.tailPivot == nil and not sheep.warnedSwayNodes then
        sheep.warnedSwayNodes = true
        motionLogger:warnOnce("sheep-sway-nodes-missing", "sheep ear/tail pivots not found; sway animation skipped")
    end
end

local function sheepApplySway()
    local time = sheep.swayTime
    local earAngle = math.sin(time * 2.2) * 3.0
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil and sheep.earLeftEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earLeftEuler
        sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil and sheep.earRightEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earRightEuler
        sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y - earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil and sheep.tailEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.tailEuler
        sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + math.sin(time * 1.7 + 0.6) * 4.0, base.z)
    end
end

local function sheepCanDrive()
    local ok, owned = pcall(
        function()
            return self:HasOwnership()
        end
    )
    if not ok or owned == true then
        return true
    end
    local ownerOk, owner = pcall(
        function()
            return self:GetOwner()
        end
    )
    if ownerOk and owner == nil then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    local actors = DouyinActorService.GetActors()
    local count = 0
    if actors ~= nil and actors.Length ~= nil then
        count = actors.Length
    end
    local nearestActor = nil
    local nearestDistance = nil
    for index = 1, count do
        local actor = actors[index]
        if actor == nil then
            actor = actors[index - 1]
        end
        if actor ~= nil and actor.isPet ~= true then
            local position = actor.position
            if position ~= nil then
                local dx = position.x - root.position.x
                local dz = position.z - root.position.z
                local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                if nearestDistance == nil or distance < nearestDistance then
                    nearestDistance = distance
                    nearestActor = actor
                end
            end
        end
    end
    sheep.threatActor = nearestActor
    sheep.threatDistance = nearestDistance
end

local function sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, turnSpeed)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local yaw = sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction)
    local maxTurn = turnSpeed * dt
    if yaw > maxTurn then
        yaw = maxTurn
    elseif yaw < -maxTurn then
        yaw = -maxTurn
    end
    if math.abs(yaw) > 0.0001 then
        hostRuntime.facingForward = rotateHorizontal(forward, yaw)
    else
        hostRuntime.facingForward = forward
    end
end

local function sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local position = root.position
    root.position = Vector3(position.x + forward.x * speed * dt, position.y, position.z + forward.z * speed * dt)
end

local function sheepPulseIdleAction()
    local roll = math.random()
    if roll < 0.5 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleGraze", self, hostRuntime)
    elseif roll < 0.75 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleChew", self, hostRuntime)
    elseif roll < 0.92 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleLookAround", self, hostRuntime)
    else
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleBaaa", self, hostRuntime)
    end
end

local function sheepEnterIdle()
    sheep.mode = "idle"
    sheep.modeTimer = sheepRandom(4.0, 8.0)
    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.5, 1.6)
    sheep.walkTarget = nil
    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleGraze", self, hostRuntime)
end

local function sheepEnterWalk(root)
    local home = sheep.home or root.position
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local radius = sheepRandom(1.2, SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS)
    sheep.walkTarget = Vector3(home.x + math.cos(angle) * radius, home.y, home.z + math.sin(angle) * radius)
    sheep.walkTimer = 0
    sheep.mode = "walk"
    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
end

local function sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    sheep.modeTimer = sheep.modeTimer - dt
    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheep.idleActionTimer - dt
    if sheep.idleActionTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(2.2, 4.8)
        sheepPulseIdleAction()
    end
    if sheep.modeTimer <= 0 then
        local root = self and self.transform or nil
        if root ~= nil then
            sheepEnterWalk(root)
        end
    end
end

local function sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    local target = sheep.walkTarget
    if target == nil then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    sheep.walkTimer = sheep.walkTimer + dt
    local dx = target.x - root.position.x
    local dz = target.z - root.position.z
    local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
    if distance <= SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE or sheep.walkTimer >= 9.0 then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    local direction = Vector3(dx / distance, 0, dz / distance)
    sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, SHEEP_TURN_SPEED)
    local speed = SHEEP_WALK_SPEED * math.max(0.25, math.min(1, distance / 1.2))
    sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
end

local function sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    sheep.fleeTimer = sheep.fleeTimer + dt
    local actor = sheep.threatActor
    local awayX = 0
    local awayZ = 0
    if actor ~= nil and actor.position ~= nil then
        awayX = root.position.x - actor.position.x
        awayZ = root.position.z - actor.position.z
    end
    local length = math.sqrt(awayX * awayX + awayZ * awayZ)
    if length < 0.0001 then
        local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
        awayX = -forward.x
        awayZ = -forward.z
        length = 1
    end
    local direction = Vector3(awayX / length, 0, awayZ / length)
    sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED)
    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or direction
    local remainingTurn = math.abs(sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction))
    local speed = SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED * math.max(0, 1 - remainingTurn / 100)
    if speed > 0.02 then
        sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    end
    local farEnough = sheep.threatDistance == nil or sheep.threatDistance >= SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS
    if (farEnough and sheep.fleeTimer >= 1.2) or sheep.fleeTimer >= 5.0 then
        sheepEnterIdle()
    end
end

local function sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
    local previous = sheep.lastObservedPosition
    local speed = 0
    if previous ~= nil and dt > 0.0001 then
        local dx = root.position.x - previous.x
        local dz = root.position.z - previous.z
        speed = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) / dt
    end
    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
    if speed > 1.1 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("run")
    elseif speed > 0.08 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    else
        sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    end
end

local function updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    local root = self and self.transform or nil
    if root == nil then
        return
    end

    if not sheep.ready then
        sheep.ready = true
        sheep.home = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.modeTimer = sheepRandom(2.5, 5.0)
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.8, 2.0)
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
        ensureFacingCalibration(root, true)
        sheepBindSwayNodes()
    end

    sheep.swayTime = sheep.swayTime + dt
    sheepApplySway()

    sheep.ownershipTimer = sheep.ownershipTimer - dt
    if sheep.ownershipTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
    end

    if not sheep.isOwner then
        sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
        return
    end

    sheep.noticeTimer = sheep.noticeTimer - dt
    if sheep.noticeTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.noticeTimer = 0.2
        sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    end

    if sheep.threatDistance ~= nil and sheep.threatDistance <= SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS and sheep.mode ~= "flee" then
        sheep.mode = "flee"
        sheep.fleeTimer = 0
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    end

    if sheep.mode == "flee" then
        sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    elseif sheep.mode == "walk" then
        sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    else
        sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    end

    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
end
-- END WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING

local function updateAutonomousMotion(dt)
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    end
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted and controlProfile == "land" then
        refreshUnmountedGroundingInternal(dt)
    end

    local toLength = math.sqrt(toVec.x * toVec.x + toVec.z * toVec.z)
    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
        return 0
    end
    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))
end

local function sheepApplyMoveMode(mode)
    if sheep.moveMode == mode then
        return
    end
    sheep.moveMode = mode
    if mode == "idle" then
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    else
        callAdapter("SetMoveMode", self, hostRuntime, mode)
    end
end

local function sheepFindNode(relativePath)
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local node = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(relativePath)
    if node ~= nil then
        return node
    end
    return runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("rig/" .. relativePath)
end

local function sheepBindSwayNodes()
    sheep.earLeft = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH)
    sheep.earRight = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH)
    sheep.tailPivot = sheepFindNode(TAIL_PIVOT_PATH)
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil then
        sheep.earLeftEuler = sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil then
        sheep.earRightEuler = sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil then
        sheep.tailEuler = sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earLeft == nil and sheep.earRight == nil and sheep.tailPivot == nil and not sheep.warnedSwayNodes then
        sheep.warnedSwayNodes = true
        motionLogger:warnOnce("sheep-sway-nodes-missing", "sheep ear/tail pivots not found; sway animation skipped")
    end
end

local function sheepApplySway()
    local time = sheep.swayTime
    local earAngle = math.sin(time * 2.2) * 3.0
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil and sheep.earLeftEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earLeftEuler
        sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil and sheep.earRightEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earRightEuler
        sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y - earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil and sheep.tailEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.tailEuler
        sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + math.sin(time * 1.7 + 0.6) * 4.0, base.z)
    end
end

local function sheepCanDrive()
    local ok, owned = pcall(
        function()
            return self:HasOwnership()
        end
    )
    if not ok or owned == true then
        return true
    end
    local ownerOk, owner = pcall(
        function()
            return self:GetOwner()
        end
    )
    if ownerOk and owner == nil then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    local actors = DouyinActorService.GetActors()
    local count = 0
    if actors ~= nil and actors.Length ~= nil then
        count = actors.Length
    end
    local nearestActor = nil
    local nearestDistance = nil
    for index = 1, count do
        local actor = actors[index]
        if actor == nil then
            actor = actors[index - 1]
        end
        if actor ~= nil and actor.isPet ~= true then
            local position = actor.position
            if position ~= nil then
                local dx = position.x - root.position.x
                local dz = position.z - root.position.z
                local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                if nearestDistance == nil or distance < nearestDistance then
                    nearestDistance = distance
                    nearestActor = actor
                end
            end
        end

    sheep.threatActor = nearestActor
    sheep.threatDistance = nearestDistance
end

local function sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, turnSpeed)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local yaw = sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction)
    local maxTurn = turnSpeed * dt
    if yaw > maxTurn then
        yaw = maxTurn
    elseif yaw < -maxTurn then
        yaw = -maxTurn
    end
    if math.abs(yaw) > 0.0001 then
        hostRuntime.facingForward = rotateHorizontal(forward, yaw)
    else
        hostRuntime.facingForward = forward
    end
end

local function sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local position = root.position
    root.position = Vector3(position.x + forward.x * speed * dt, position.y, position.z + forward.z * speed * dt)
end

local function sheepPulseIdleAction()

    if roll < 0.5 then

    elseif roll < 0.75 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleChew", self, hostRuntime)
    elseif roll < 0.92 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleLookAround", self, hostRuntime)
    else
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleBaaa", self, hostRuntime)
    end
end

    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.5, 1.6)

    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")

end

local function sheepEnterWalk(root)
    local home = sheep.home or root.position
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local radius = sheepRandom(1.2, SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS)
    sheep.walkTarget = Vector3(home.x + math.cos(angle) * radius, home.y, home.z + math.sin(angle) * radius)
    sheep.walkTimer = 0
    sheep.mode = "walk"
    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
end

local function sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    sheep.modeTimer = sheep.modeTimer - dt
    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheep.idleActionTimer - dt
    if sheep.idleActionTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(2.2, 4.8)
        sheepPulseIdleAction()
    end
    if sheep.modeTimer <= 0 then
        local root = self and self.transform or nil
        if root ~= nil then
            sheepEnterWalk(root)
        end
    end
end

local function sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    local target = sheep.walkTarget
    if target == nil then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    sheep.walkTimer = sheep.walkTimer + dt
    local dx = target.x - root.position.x
    local dz = target.z - root.position.z
    local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
    if distance <= SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE or sheep.walkTimer >= 9.0 then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    local direction = Vector3(dx / distance, 0, dz / distance)
    sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, SHEEP_TURN_SPEED)
    local speed = SHEEP_WALK_SPEED * math.max(0.25, math.min(1, distance / 1.2))
    sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
end

local function sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    sheep.fleeTimer = sheep.fleeTimer + dt
    local actor = sheep.threatActor
    local awayX = 0
    local awayZ = 0
    if actor ~= nil and actor.position ~= nil then
        awayX = root.position.x - actor.position.x
        awayZ = root.position.z - actor.position.z
    end
    local length = math.sqrt(awayX * awayX + awayZ * awayZ)
    if length < 0.0001 then
        local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
        awayX = -forward.x
        awayZ = -forward.z
        length = 1
    end
    local direction = Vector3(awayX / length, 0, awayZ / length)

    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or direction
    local remainingTurn = math.abs(sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction))
    local speed = SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED * math.max(0, 1 - remainingTurn / 100)
    if speed > 0.02 then
        sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    end
    local farEnough = sheep.threatDistance == nil or sheep.threatDistance >= SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS
    if (farEnough and sheep.fleeTimer >= 1.2) or sheep.fleeTimer >= 5.0 then
        sheepEnterIdle()
    end
end

local function sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
    local previous = sheep.lastObservedPosition
    local speed = 0
    if previous ~= nil and dt > 0.0001 then
        local dx = root.position.x - previous.x
        local dz = root.position.z - previous.z
        speed = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) / dt
    end
    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
    if speed > 1.1 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("run")
    elseif speed > 0.08 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    else
        sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    end
end

local function updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    local root = self and self.transform or nil
    if root == nil then
        return
    end

    if not sheep.ready then
        sheep.ready = true
        sheep.home = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.modeTimer = sheepRandom(2.5, 5.0)
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.8, 2.0)
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
        ensureFacingCalibration(root, true)
        sheepBindSwayNodes()
    end

    sheep.swayTime = sheep.swayTime + dt
    sheepApplySway()

    sheep.ownershipTimer = sheep.ownershipTimer - dt
    if sheep.ownershipTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
    end

    if not sheep.isOwner then
        sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
        return
    end

    sheep.noticeTimer = sheep.noticeTimer - dt
    if sheep.noticeTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.noticeTimer = 0.2
        sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    end

    if sheep.threatDistance ~= nil and sheep.threatDistance <= SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS and sheep.mode ~= "flee" then
        sheep.mode = "flee"
        sheep.fleeTimer = 0
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    end

    if sheep.mode == "flee" then
        sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    elseif sheep.mode == "walk" then
        sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    else
        sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    end

    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
end
-- END WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING

local function updateAutonomousMotion(dt)
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    end
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted and controlProfile == "land" then
        refreshUnmountedGroundingInternal(dt)
    end

+-- BEGIN WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING
+-- Ambient sheep behaviour: slow wandering, grazing pauses and stepping away from nearby players.
+-- The animator supplies leg, body and head motion; this block only steers the root and picks states.
+local DouyinActorService = CS.DouyinActorService
+
+local SHEEP_WALK_SPEED = 0.65
+local SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED = 1.35
+local SHEEP_TURN_SPEED = 70
+local SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED = 110
+local SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS = 2.2
+local SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS = 5.5
+local SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS = 4.5

+    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_R"

+

+    modeTimer = 0,

+    walkTimer = 0,

+    noticeTimer = 0,

+    walkTarget = nil,
+    threatActor = nil,
+    threatDistance = nil,

+    earLeft = nil,
+    earRight = nil,
+    tailPivot = nil,
+    earLeftEuler = nil,
+    earRightEuler = nil,
+    tailEuler = nil,
+    warnedSwayNodes = false,
+    lastObservedPosition = nil,
+}
+
+local function sheepRandom(minValue, maxValue)
+    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
+end
+
+-- atan2 kept explicit so the script does not depend on a two-argument math.atan.
+local function sheepAtan2(y, x)
+    if x > 0 then
+        return math.atan(y / x)
+    end
+    if x < 0 then
+        if y >= 0 then
+            return math.atan(y / x) + math.pi
+        end
+        return math.atan(y / x) - math.pi
+    end
+    if y > 0 then
+        return math.pi * 0.5
+    end
+    if y < 0 then
+        return -math.pi * 0.5
+    end
+    return 0
+end

+local function sheepSignedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
+    local fromLength = math.sqrt(fromVec.x * fromVec.x + fromVec.z * fromVec.z)

+    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
+        return 0
+    end
+    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
+    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
+    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
+    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
+    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
+    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
+    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
+    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))

-- BEGIN WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING
-- Ambient sheep behaviour: slow wandering, grazing pauses and stepping away from nearby players.
-- The animator supplies leg, body and head motion; this block only steers the root and picks states.
local DouyinActorService = CS.DouyinActorService

local SHEEP_WALK_SPEED = 0.65
local SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED = 1.35
local SHEEP_TURN_SPEED = 70
local SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED = 110
local SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS = 2.2
local SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS = 5.5
local SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS = 4.5
local SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE = 0.4
local EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_L"
local EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_R"
local TAIL_PIVOT_PATH = "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Tail/SHEEP_ Tail1/SHEEP_ Tail2/TailPivot"

local sheep = {
    ready = false,
    mode = "idle",
    moveMode = nil,
    modeTimer = 0,
    idleActionTimer = 0,
    walkTimer = 0,
    fleeTimer = 0,
    noticeTimer = 0,
    ownershipTimer = 0,
    isOwner = true,
    home = nil,
    walkTarget = nil,
    threatActor = nil,
    threatDistance = nil,
    swayTime = 0,
    earLeft = nil,
    earRight = nil,
    tailPivot = nil,
    earLeftEuler = nil,
    earRightEuler = nil,
    tailEuler = nil,
    warnedSwayNodes = false,
    lastObservedPosition = nil,
}

local function sheepRandom(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

-- atan2 kept explicit so the script does not depend on a two-argument math.atan.
local function sheepAtan2(y, x)
    if x > 0 then
        return math.atan(y / x)
    end
    if x < 0 then
        if y >= 0 then
            return math.atan(y / x) + math.pi
        end
        return math.atan(y / x) - math.pi
    end
    if y > 0 then
        return math.pi * 0.5
    end
    if y < 0 then
        return -math.pi * 0.5
    end
    return 0
end

local function sheepSignedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
    local fromLength = math.sqrt(fromVec.x * fromVec.x + fromVec.z * fromVec.z)
    local toLength = math.sqrt(toVec.x * toVec.x + toVec.z * toVec.z)
    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
        return 0
    end
    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))
end

local function sheepApplyMoveMode(mode)
    if sheep.moveMode == mode then
        return
    end
    sheep.moveMode = mode
    if mode == "idle" then
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    else
        callAdapter("SetMoveMode", self, hostRuntime, mode)
    end
end

local function sheepFindNode(relativePath)
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local node = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(relativePath)
    if node ~= nil then
        return node
    end
    return runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("rig/" .. relativePath)
end

local function sheepBindSwayNodes()
    sheep.earLeft = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH)
    sheep.earRight = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH)
    sheep.tailPivot = sheepFindNode(TAIL_PIVOT_PATH)
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil then
        sheep.earLeftEuler = sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil then
        sheep.earRightEuler = sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil then
        sheep.tailEuler = sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earLeft == nil and sheep.earRight == nil and sheep.tailPivot == nil and not sheep.warnedSwayNodes then
        sheep.warnedSwayNodes = true
        motionLogger:warnOnce("sheep-sway-nodes-missing", "sheep ear/tail pivots not found; sway animation skipped")
    end
end

local function sheepApplySway()
    local time = sheep.swayTime
    local earAngle = math.sin(time * 2.2) * 3.0
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil and sheep.earLeftEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earLeftEuler
        sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil and sheep.earRightEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earRightEuler
        sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y - earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil and sheep.tailEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.tailEuler
        sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + math.sin(time * 1.7 + 0.6) * 4.0, base.z)
    end
end

local function sheepCanDrive()
    local ok, owned = pcall(
        function()
            return self:HasOwnership()
        end
    )
    if not ok or owned == true then
        return true
    end
    local ownerOk, owner = pcall(
        function()
            return self:GetOwner()
        end
    )
    if ownerOk and owner == nil then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    if DouyinActorService == nil then
        sheep.threatActor = nil
        sheep.threatDistance = nil
        return
    end
    local ok, actors = pcall(
        function()
            return DouyinActorService.GetActors()
        end
    )
    if not ok then
        sheep.threatActor = nil
        sheep.threatDistance = nil
        return
    end
    local count = 0
    if actors ~= nil and actors.Length ~= nil then
        count = actors.Length
    end
    local nearestActor = nil
    local nearestDistance = nil
    local nearestX = nil
    local nearestZ = nil
    for index = 1, count do
        local actor = actors[index]
        if actor == nil then
            actor = actors[index - 1]
        end
        if actor ~= nil and actor.isPet ~= true then
            local position = actor.position
            if position ~= nil then
                local dx = position.x - root.position.x
                local dz = position.z - root.position.z
                local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                if nearestDistance == nil or distance < nearestDistance then
                    nearestDistance = distance
                    nearestActor = actor
                    nearestX = position.x
                    nearestZ = position.z
                end
            end
        end
    end
    sheep.threatActor = nearestActor
    sheep.threatDistance = nearestDistance
    sheep.threatX = nearestX
    sheep.threatZ = nearestZ
end

local function sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, turnSpeed)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local yaw = sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction)
    local maxTurn = turnSpeed * dt
    if yaw > maxTurn then
        yaw = maxTurn
    elseif yaw < -maxTurn then
        yaw = -maxTurn
    end
    if math.abs(yaw) > 0.0001 then
        hostRuntime.facingForward = rotateHorizontal(forward, yaw)
    else
        hostRuntime.facingForward = forward
    end
end

local function sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local position = root.position
    root.position = Vector3(position.x + forward.x * speed * dt, position.y, position.z + forward.z * speed * dt)
end

-- BEGIN WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING
-- Ambient sheep behaviour: slow wandering, grazing pauses and stepping away from nearby players.
-- The animator supplies leg, body and head motion; this block only steers the root and picks states.
local DouyinActorService = CS.DouyinActorService

local SHEEP_WALK_SPEED = 0.65
local SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED = 1.35
local SHEEP_TURN_SPEED = 70
local SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED = 110
local SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS = 2.2
local SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS = 5.5
local SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS = 4.5
local SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE = 0.4
local EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_L"
local EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_R"
local TAIL_PIVOT_PATH = "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Tail/SHEEP_ Tail1/SHEEP_ Tail2/TailPivot"

local sheep = {
    ready = false,
    mode = "idle",
    moveMode = nil,
    modeTimer = 0,
    idleActionTimer = 0,
    walkTimer = 0,
    fleeTimer = 0,
    noticeTimer = 0,
    ownershipTimer = 0,
    isOwner = true,
    home = nil,
    walkTarget = nil,
    threatActor = nil,
    threatDistance = nil,
    swayTime = 0,
    earLeft = nil,
    earRight = nil,
    tailPivot = nil,
    earLeftEuler = nil,
    earRightEuler = nil,
    tailEuler = nil,
    warnedSwayNodes = false,
    lastObservedPosition = nil,
}

local function sheepRandom(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

-- atan2 kept explicit so the script does not depend on a two-argument math.atan.
local function sheepAtan2(y, x)
    if x > 0 then
        return math.atan(y / x)
    end
    if x < 0 then
        if y >= 0 then
            return math.atan(y / x) + math.pi
        end
        return math.atan(y / x) - math.pi
    end
    if y > 0 then
        return math.pi * 0.5
    end
    if y < 0 then
        return -math.pi * 0.5
    end
    return 0
end

local function sheepSignedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
    local fromLength = math.sqrt(fromVec.x * fromVec.x + fromVec.z * fromVec.z)
    local toLength = math.sqrt(toVec.x * toVec.x + toVec.z * toVec.z)
    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
        return 0
    end
    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))
end

local function sheepApplyMoveMode(mode)
    if sheep.moveMode == mode then
        return
    end
    sheep.moveMode = mode
    if mode == "idle" then
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    else
        callAdapter("SetMoveMode", self, hostRuntime, mode)
    end
end

local function sheepFindNode(relativePath)
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local node = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(relativePath)
    if node ~= nil then
        return node
    end
    return runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("rig/" .. relativePath)
end

local function sheepBindSwayNodes()
    sheep.earLeft = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH)
    sheep.earRight = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH)
    sheep.tailPivot = sheepFindNode(TAIL_PIVOT_PATH)
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil then
        sheep.earLeftEuler = sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil then
        sheep.earRightEuler = sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil then
        sheep.tailEuler = sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earLeft == nil and sheep.earRight == nil and sheep.tailPivot == nil and not sheep.warnedSwayNodes then
        sheep.warnedSwayNodes = true
        motionLogger:warnOnce("sheep-sway-nodes-missing", "sheep ear/tail pivots not found; sway animation skipped")
    end
end

local function sheepApplySway()
    local time = sheep.swayTime
    local earAngle = math.sin(time * 2.2) * 3.0
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil and sheep.earLeftEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earLeftEuler
        sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil and sheep.earRightEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earRightEuler
        sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y - earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil and sheep.tailEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.tailEuler
        sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + math.sin(time * 1.7 + 0.6) * 4.0, base.z)
    end
end

local function sheepCanDrive()
    local ok, owned = pcall(
        function()
            return self:HasOwnership()
        end
    )
    if not ok or owned == true then
        return true
    end
    local ownerOk, owner = pcall(
        function()
            return self:GetOwner()
        end
    )
    if ownerOk and owner == nil then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    if DouyinActorService == nil then
        sheep.threatActor = nil
        sheep.threatDistance = nil
        return
    end
    local ok, actors = pcall(
        function()
            return DouyinActorService.GetActors()
        end
    )
    if not ok then
        sheep.threatActor = nil
        sheep.threatDistance = nil
        return
    end
    local count = 0
    if actors ~= nil and actors.Length ~= nil then
        count = actors.Length
    end
    local nearestActor = nil
    local nearestDistance = nil
    local nearestX = nil
    local nearestZ = nil
    for index = 1, count do
        local actor = actors[index]
        if actor == nil then
            actor = actors[index - 1]
        end
        if actor ~= nil and actor.isPet ~= true then
            local position = actor.position
            if position ~= nil then
                local dx = position.x - root.position.x
                local dz = position.z - root.position.z
                local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                if nearestDistance == nil or distance < nearestDistance then
                    nearestDistance = distance
                    nearestActor = actor
                    nearestX = position.x
                    nearestZ = position.z
                end
            end
        end
    end
    sheep.threatActor = nearestActor
    sheep.threatDistance = nearestDistance
    sheep.threatX = nearestX
    sheep.threatZ = nearestZ
end

local function sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, turnSpeed)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local yaw = sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction)
    local maxTurn = turnSpeed * dt
    if yaw > maxTurn then
        yaw = maxTurn
    elseif yaw < -maxTurn then
        yaw = -maxTurn
    end
    if math.abs(yaw) > 0.0001 then
        hostRuntime.facingForward = rotateHorizontal(forward, yaw)
    else
        hostRuntime.facingForward = forward
    end
end

local function sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local position = root.position
    root.position = Vector3(position.x + forward.x * speed * dt, position.y, position.z + forward.z * speed * dt)
end

-- BEGIN WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING
-- Ambient sheep behaviour: slow wandering, grazing pauses and stepping away from nearby players.
-- The animator supplies leg, body and head motion; this block only steers the root and picks states.
local DouyinActorService = CS.DouyinActorService

local SHEEP_WALK_SPEED = 0.65
local SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED = 1.35
local SHEEP_TURN_SPEED = 70
local SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED = 110
local SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS = 2.2
local SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS = 5.5
local SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS = 4.5
local SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE = 0.4
local EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_L"
local EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH =
    "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Spine/SHEEP_ Spine1/SHEEP_ Neck/SHEEP_ Neck1/SHEEP_ Neck2/SHEEP_ Head/EarPivot_R"
local TAIL_PIVOT_PATH = "SK_Sheep/root/SHEEP_/SHEEP_ Pelvis/SHEEP_ Tail/SHEEP_ Tail1/SHEEP_ Tail2/TailPivot"

local sheep = {
    ready = false,
    mode = "idle",
    moveMode = nil,
    modeTimer = 0,
    idleActionTimer = 0,
    walkTimer = 0,
    fleeTimer = 0,
    noticeTimer = 0,
    ownershipTimer = 0,
    isOwner = true,
    home = nil,
    walkTarget = nil,
    threatActor = nil,
    threatDistance = nil,
    swayTime = 0,
    earLeft = nil,
    earRight = nil,
    tailPivot = nil,
    earLeftEuler = nil,
    earRightEuler = nil,
    tailEuler = nil,
    warnedSwayNodes = false,
    lastObservedPosition = nil,
}

local function sheepRandom(minValue, maxValue)
    return minValue + math.random() * (maxValue - minValue)
end

-- atan2 kept explicit so the script does not depend on a two-argument math.atan.
local function sheepAtan2(y, x)
    if x > 0 then
        return math.atan(y / x)
    end
    if x < 0 then
        if y >= 0 then
            return math.atan(y / x) + math.pi
        end
        return math.atan(y / x) - math.pi
    end
    if y > 0 then
        return math.pi * 0.5
    end
    if y < 0 then
        return -math.pi * 0.5
    end
    return 0
end

local function sheepSignedYawDegrees(fromVec, toVec)
    local fromLength = math.sqrt(fromVec.x * fromVec.x + fromVec.z * fromVec.z)
    local toLength = math.sqrt(toVec.x * toVec.x + toVec.z * toVec.z)
    if fromLength < 0.0001 or toLength < 0.0001 then
        return 0
    end
    local fromX = fromVec.x / fromLength
    local fromZ = fromVec.z / fromLength
    local toX = toVec.x / toLength
    local toZ = toVec.z / toLength
    local cross = fromX * toZ - fromZ * toX
    local dot = fromX * toX + fromZ * toZ
    dot = math.max(-1, math.min(1, dot))
    return math.deg(sheepAtan2(cross, dot))
end

local function sheepApplyMoveMode(mode)
    if sheep.moveMode == mode then
        return
    end
    sheep.moveMode = mode
    if mode == "idle" then
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    else
        callAdapter("SetMoveMode", self, hostRuntime, mode)
    end
end

local function sheepFindNode(relativePath)
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local node = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(relativePath)
    if node ~= nil then
        return node
    end
    return runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("rig/" .. relativePath)
end

local function sheepBindSwayNodes()
    sheep.earLeft = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_LEFT_PATH)
    sheep.earRight = sheepFindNode(EAR_PIVOT_RIGHT_PATH)
    sheep.tailPivot = sheepFindNode(TAIL_PIVOT_PATH)
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil then
        sheep.earLeftEuler = sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil then
        sheep.earRightEuler = sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil then
        sheep.tailEuler = sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles
    end
    if sheep.earLeft == nil and sheep.earRight == nil and sheep.tailPivot == nil and not sheep.warnedSwayNodes then
        sheep.warnedSwayNodes = true
        motionLogger:warnOnce("sheep-sway-nodes-missing", "sheep ear/tail pivots not found; sway animation skipped")
    end
end

local function sheepApplySway()
    local time = sheep.swayTime
    local earAngle = math.sin(time * 2.2) * 3.0
    if sheep.earLeft ~= nil and sheep.earLeftEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earLeftEuler
        sheep.earLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.earRight ~= nil and sheep.earRightEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.earRightEuler
        sheep.earRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y - earAngle, base.z)
    end
    if sheep.tailPivot ~= nil and sheep.tailEuler ~= nil then
        local base = sheep.tailEuler
        sheep.tailPivot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(base.x, base.y + math.sin(time * 1.7 + 0.6) * 4.0, base.z)
    end
end

local function sheepCanDrive()
    local ok, owned = pcall(
        function()
            return self:HasOwnership()
        end
    )
    if not ok or owned == true then
        return true
    end
    local ownerOk, owner = pcall(
        function()
            return self:GetOwner()
        end
    )
    if ownerOk and owner == nil then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    if DouyinActorService == nil then
        sheep.threatActor = nil
        sheep.threatDistance = nil
        return
    end
    local ok, actors = pcall(
        function()
            return DouyinActorService.GetActors()
        end
    )
    if not ok then
        sheep.threatActor = nil
        sheep.threatDistance = nil
        return
    end
    local count = 0
    if actors ~= nil and actors.Length ~= nil then
        count = actors.Length
    end
    local nearestActor = nil
    local nearestDistance = nil
    local nearestX = nil
    local nearestZ = nil
    for index = 1, count do
        local actor = actors[index]
        if actor == nil then
            actor = actors[index - 1]
        end
        if actor ~= nil and actor.isPet ~= true then
            local position = actor.position
            if position ~= nil then
                local dx = position.x - root.position.x
                local dz = position.z - root.position.z
                local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                if nearestDistance == nil or distance < nearestDistance then
                    nearestDistance = distance
                    nearestActor = actor
                    nearestX = position.x
                    nearestZ = position.z
                end
            end
        end
    end
    sheep.threatActor = nearestActor
    sheep.threatDistance = nearestDistance
    sheep.threatX = nearestX
    sheep.threatZ = nearestZ
end

local function sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, turnSpeed)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local yaw = sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction)
    local maxTurn = turnSpeed * dt
    if yaw > maxTurn then
        yaw = maxTurn
    elseif yaw < -maxTurn then
        yaw = -maxTurn
    end
    if math.abs(yaw) > 0.0001 then
        hostRuntime.facingForward = rotateHorizontal(forward, yaw)
    else
        hostRuntime.facingForward = forward
    end
end

local function sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local position = root.position
    root.position = Vector3(position.x + forward.x * speed * dt, position.y, position.z + forward.z * speed * dt)
end

local function sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
    local position = root.position
    root.position = Vector3(position.x + forward.x * speed * dt, position.y, position.z + forward.z * speed * dt)
end

local function sheepPulseIdleAction()
    local roll = math.random()
    if roll < 0.5 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleGraze", self, hostRuntime)
    elseif roll < 0.75 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleChew", self, hostRuntime)
    elseif roll < 0.92 then
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleLookAround", self, hostRuntime)
    else
        callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleBaaa", self, hostRuntime)
    end
end

local function sheepEnterIdle()
    sheep.mode = "idle"
    sheep.modeTimer = sheepRandom(4.0, 8.0)
    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.5, 1.6)
    sheep.walkTarget = nil
    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    callAdapter("PulseTriggerIdleGraze", self, hostRuntime)
end

local function sheepEnterWalk(root)
    local home = sheep.home or root.position
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local radius = sheepRandom(1.2, SHEEP_WANDER_RADIUS)
    sheep.walkTarget = Vector3(home.x + math.cos(angle) * radius, home.y, home.z + math.sin(angle) * radius)
    sheep.walkTimer = 0
    sheep.mode = "walk"
    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
end

local function sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    sheep.modeTimer = sheep.modeTimer - dt
    sheep.idleActionTimer = sheep.idleActionTimer - dt
    if sheep.idleActionTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(2.2, 4.8)
        sheepPulseIdleAction()
    end
    if sheep.modeTimer <= 0 then
        local root = self and self.transform or nil
        if root ~= nil then
            sheepEnterWalk(root)
        end
    end
end

local function sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    local target = sheep.walkTarget
    if target == nil then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    sheep.walkTimer = sheep.walkTimer + dt
    local dx = target.x - root.position.x
    local dz = target.z - root.position.z
    local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
    if distance <= SHEEP_ARRIVE_DISTANCE or sheep.walkTimer >= 9.0 then
        sheepEnterIdle()
        return
    end
    local direction = Vector3(dx / distance, 0, dz / distance)
    sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, SHEEP_TURN_SPEED)
    local speed = SHEEP_WALK_SPEED * math.max(0.25, math.min(1, distance / 1.2))
    sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
end

local function sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    sheep.fleeTimer = sheep.fleeTimer + dt
    local awayX = 0
    local awayZ = 0
    if sheep.threatX ~= nil and sheep.threatZ ~= nil then
        awayX = root.position.x - sheep.threatX
        awayZ = root.position.z - sheep.threatZ
    end
    local length = math.sqrt(awayX * awayX + awayZ * awayZ)
    if length < 0.0001 then
        local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or getHorizontalForward(root)
        awayX = -forward.x
        awayZ = -forward.z
        length = 1
    end
    local direction = Vector3(awayX / length, 0, awayZ / length)
    sheepSteerTowards(root, direction, dt, SHEEP_FLEE_TURN_SPEED)
    sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    local forward = hostRuntime.facingForward or direction
    local remainingTurn = math.abs(sheepSignedYawDegrees(forward, direction))
    local speed = SHEEP_FLEE_SPEED * math.max(0, 1 - remainingTurn / 100)
    if speed > 0.02 then
        sheepMoveForward(root, speed, dt)
    end
    local farEnough = sheep.threatDistance == nil or sheep.threatDistance >= SHEEP_CALM_RADIUS
    if (farEnough and sheep.fleeTimer >= 1.2) or sheep.fleeTimer >= 5.0 then
        sheepEnterIdle()
    end
end

local function sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
    local previous = sheep.lastObservedPosition
    local speed = 0
    if previous ~= nil and dt > 0.0001 then
        local dx = root.position.x - previous.x
        local dz = root.position.z - previous.z
        speed = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) / dt
    end
    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
    if speed > 1.1 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("run")
    elseif speed > 0.08 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    else
        sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    end
end

local function updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    local root = self and self.transform or nil
    if root == nil then
        return
    end

    if not sheep.ready then
        sheep.ready = true
        sheep.home = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.modeTimer = sheepRandom(2.5, 5.0)
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.8, 2.0)
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
        ensureFacingCalibration(root, true)
        sheepBindSwayNodes()
    end

    sheep.swayTime = sheep.swayTime + dt
    sheepApplySway()

    sheep.ownershipTimer = sheep.ownershipTimer - dt
    if sheep.ownershipTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
    end

    if not sheep.isOwner then
        sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
        return
    end

    sheep.noticeTimer = sheep.noticeTimer - dt
    if sheep.noticeTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.noticeTimer = 0.2
        sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    end

    if sheep.threatDistance ~= nil and sheep.threatDistance <= SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS and sheep.mode ~= "flee" then
        sheep.mode = "flee"
        sheep.fleeTimer = 0
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    end

    if sheep.mode == "flee" then
        sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    elseif sheep.mode == "walk" then
        sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    else
        sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    end

    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
end
-- END WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING

local function updateAutonomousMotion(dt)
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    end
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted and controlProfile == "land" then
        refreshUnmountedGroundingInternal(dt)
    end
    if capability == "2" then
        ensureNeutralIdleBootstrap()
        return
    end
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        ensureNeutralIdleBootstrap()
    end
    -- Workspace-specific autonomous branches may be appended later.
end

function GetRigControlProfile()
    return controlProfile
end

function SetMountedRider(actorOrNil)
    hostRuntime.mountedRider = actorOrNil
    hostRuntime.isMounted = actorOrNil ~= nil
    hostRuntime.visualStateKey = nil
    if hostRuntime.isMounted then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = resolveMountedIdleMode()
        hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent = 0
        hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight = self ~= nil and self.transform ~= nil and self.transform.position.y or nil
        hostRuntime.mountedAirborne = false
        hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = false
        ensureFacingCalibration(self and self.transform or nil, true)
    else
        clearMountedIntents()
        clearGroundingState()
        hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight = nil
        hostRuntime.mountedGroundClearance = nil
        hostRuntime.mountedAirborne = false
        hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = false
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    end
    callAdapter("OnMountedStateChanged", self, hostRuntime, hostRuntime.isMounted, actorOrNil)
    if hostRuntime.isMounted then
        refreshMountedGroundingInternal(true)
    end
end

function ClearMountedRider()
    SetMountedRider(nil)
end

function SetMountedMoveIntent(forwardIntent, strafeIntent)
    hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent = tonumber(forwardIntent) or 0
    if math.abs(hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent) < 0.08 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "idle"
    elseif hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent > 0.75 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "run"
    elseif hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent > 0 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "walk"

    if speed > 1.1 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("run")
    elseif speed > 0.08 then
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    else
        sheepApplyMoveMode("idle")
    end
end

local function updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    local root = self and self.transform or nil
    if root == nil then
        return
    end

    if not sheep.ready then
        sheep.ready = true
        sheep.home = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
        sheep.modeTimer = sheepRandom(2.5, 5.0)
        sheep.idleActionTimer = sheepRandom(0.8, 2.0)
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
        ensureFacingCalibration(root, true)
        sheepBindSwayNodes()
    end

    sheep.swayTime = sheep.swayTime + dt
    sheepApplySway()

    sheep.ownershipTimer = sheep.ownershipTimer - dt
    if sheep.ownershipTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.ownershipTimer = 0.6
        sheep.isOwner = sheepCanDrive()
    end

    if not sheep.isOwner then
        sheepUpdateRemote(root, dt)
        return
    end

    sheep.noticeTimer = sheep.noticeTimer - dt
    if sheep.noticeTimer <= 0 then
        sheep.noticeTimer = 0.2
        sheepRefreshThreat(root)
    end

    if sheep.threatDistance ~= nil and sheep.threatDistance <= SHEEP_NOTICE_RADIUS and sheep.mode ~= "flee" then
        sheep.mode = "flee"
        sheep.fleeTimer = 0
        sheepApplyMoveMode("walk")
    end

    if sheep.mode == "flee" then
        sheepUpdateFlee(root, dt)
    elseif sheep.mode == "walk" then
        sheepUpdateWalk(root, dt)
    else
        sheepUpdateIdle(dt)
    end

    sheep.lastObservedPosition = Vector3(root.position.x, root.position.y, root.position.z)
end
-- END WORKSPACE SHEEP ROAMING

local function updateAutonomousMotion(dt)
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        updateSheepRoaming(dt)
    end
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted and controlProfile == "land" then
        refreshUnmountedGroundingInternal(dt)
    end
    if capability == "2" then
        ensureNeutralIdleBootstrap()
        return
    end
    if not hostRuntime.isMounted then
        ensureNeutralIdleBootstrap()
    end
    -- Workspace-specific autonomous branches may be appended later.
end

function GetRigControlProfile()
    return controlProfile
end

function SetMountedRider(actorOrNil)
    hostRuntime.mountedRider = actorOrNil
    hostRuntime.isMounted = actorOrNil ~= nil
    hostRuntime.visualStateKey = nil
    if hostRuntime.isMounted then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = resolveMountedIdleMode()
        hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent = 0
        hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight = self ~= nil and self.transform ~= nil and self.transform.position.y or nil
        hostRuntime.mountedAirborne = false
        hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = false
        ensureFacingCalibration(self and self.transform or nil, true)
    else
        clearMountedIntents()
        clearGroundingState()
        hostRuntime.mountedBaseHeight = nil
        hostRuntime.mountedGroundClearance = nil
        hostRuntime.mountedAirborne = false
        hostRuntime.mountedTakeoffPlayed = false
        applyNeutralIdleDefaults()
    end
    callAdapter("OnMountedStateChanged", self, hostRuntime, hostRuntime.isMounted, actorOrNil)
    if hostRuntime.isMounted then
        refreshMountedGroundingInternal(true)
    end
end

function ClearMountedRider()
    SetMountedRider(nil)
end

function SetMountedMoveIntent(forwardIntent, strafeIntent)
    hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent = tonumber(forwardIntent) or 0
    if math.abs(hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent) < 0.08 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "idle"
    elseif hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent > 0.75 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "run"
    elseif hostRuntime.mountedForwardIntent > 0 then
        hostRuntime.mountedMoveMode = "walk"

import re
p='assets/module/module-realistic-sheep/scripts/ms-root.lua'
lines=open(p).read().split('\n')
top=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    if re.match(r'^local\s', l):
        top.append((i,l.strip()[:70]))
print('top-level local declarations:', len(top))
# count names declared (may declare multiple)
names=0
for i,l in top:
    m=re.match(r'^local\s+function\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', l) or re.match(r'^local\s+([A-Za-z0-9_,\s]+)=', l)
    if m:
        names += len([x for x in m.group(1).split(',') if x.strip()])
print('approx locals:', names)
print('last few:', top[-8:])
EOF
